Das aayatein aur jannat ki zamanat. Nasai, Tirmidhi aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Hazrat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab wahi utarti toh ek aisi meethi meethi, bheeni bheeni, halki halki si aawaz aap ke paas suni jaati jaise shehad ki makkhiyon ke udne ki bhanbhanahat ki hoti hai. Ek martaba yahi halat tari hui. Thodi der ke baad jab wahi utar chuki toh aap ne Qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar apne dono haath utha kar yeh dua padhi ke Aye Allah tu hamein zyada kar, kam na kar, hamara ikram kar, ihanat na kar, hamein inaam ata farma, mehroom na rakh, hamein dusron ke muqable mein fazeelat de, hum par dusron ko pasand na farma, hum se khush ho ja aur hamein khush kar de. Arabi ke alfaaz yeh hain. Dua: (Allahumma zidna wala tanqusna wa akrimna wala tuhinna wa a'tina wala tahrimna wa athirna wala tu'thir 'alaina wardha 'anna wardhina). Phir farmaya mujh par das aayatein utri hain, jo in par jam gaya woh Jannati ho gaya. Phir aap ne mandarja bala das aayatein tilawat farmayin. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) is hadith ko munkar batate hain, kyunke is ka rawi sirf Yunus bin Saleem hai jo muhaddiseen ke nazdeek maroof nahin. Nasai mein hai Hazrat-e-Aisha (R.A) se An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aadat-o-akhlaq ki babat sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khulq Quran tha, phir in aayaton ki (Yuhafizoon) tak tilawat farmayi. Aur farmaya yahi Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke akhlaq thay. Marwi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Jannat-e-Adan paida ki aur is mein darakht waghera apne haath se lagaye toh ise dekh kar farmaya kuch bol. Is ne yahi aayatein tilawat keen jo Quran mein nazil huin. Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain ke is ki ek eent sone ki aur dusri chandi ki hai. Farishtay is mein jab dakhil hue, kehne lage wah wah yeh toh badshahon ki jagah hai. Aur riwayat mein hai is ka gara mushk ka tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is mein woh woh cheezein hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhein, na kisi dil mein samayin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jannat ne jab in aayaton ki tilawat ki toh Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya mujhe apni buzurgi aur jalal ki qasam tujh mein bakheel hargiz dakhil nahin ho sakta. Aur hadith mein hai ke is ki ek eent safed moti ki hai aur dusri surkh yaqoot ki aur teesri sabz zabarjad ki. Is ka gara mushk ka hai is ki ghaas zafran hai. Is riwayat ke aakhir mein hai ke is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat (Wa man yuuqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ula-ika humul muflihoon) (59. Al-Hashr: 9) padhi. Al-gharaz farman hai ke momin murad ko pahunch gaye, woh sa'adat pa gaye, unhon ne nijat pa li. In mominon ki shaan yeh hai ke woh apni namazon mein Allah ka khauf rakhte hain khushoo aur sukoon ke sath namaz ada karte hain. Dil hazir rakhte hain, nigahain neechi hoti hain, bazu jhuke hue hote hain. Muhammad bin Sireen (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle apni nigahain aasman ki taraf uthate thay. Lekin is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad un ki nigahain neechi ho gayin, sajde ki jagah se apni nigah nahin hatate thay.

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke jaye namaz se idhar udhar unki nazar nahin jati thi agar kisi ko is ke siwa aadat pad gayi ho to use chahiye ke apni nigahain neechi kar le. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle aisa kiya karte the. Pas yeh khuzu-o-khushu usi shakhs ko hasil ho sakta hai, jis ka dil farigh ho, khuloos hasil ho aur namaz mein poori dilchaspi ho aur tamam kamon se zyada isi mein dil lagta ho. Chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein hai Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe khushbu aur auratein zyada pasand hain aur meri aankhon ki thandak namaz mein rakh di gayi hai (Nasa'i). Ek Ansari sahabi (R.A) ne namaz ke waqt apni laundi se kaha ke pani lao, namaz padh kar rahat hasil karoon to sunne walon ko unki yeh baat garan guzri. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se farmate the. Ae Bilal utho aur namaz ke sath hamain rahat pahunchao. Mominon ke ausaf phir aur wasf bayan hua ke woh batil, shirk, gunah aur har ek behuda aur be-faida qaul-o-amal se bachte hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Waza marru billaghwi marru kirama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 72) woh laghw baat se buzurgana guzar jate hain woh burai aur be-sud kamon se Allah Ta'ala ki rok ki wajah se ruk jate hain. Aur unka yeh wasf hai ke yeh maal ki zakat ada karte hain. Aksar mufassireen yahi farmate hain lekin is mein ek baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai aur zakat ki farziyat hijrat ke dusre saal mein hoti hai phir Makki aayat mein iska bayan kaise? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke asal zakat to Makkah mein wajib ho chuki thi han is ki miqdar, maal ka nisab wagairah yeh sab ahkam Madine mein muqarrar hue. Dekhiye Surah An'am bhi Makki hai aur is mein yahi zakat ka hukm majood hai aayat (Wa aatu haqqahu yauma hasadihi wala tusrifu) (Surah Al-An'am: 141) yani kheti ke katne wale din is ki zakat ada kar diya karo. Han yeh bhi ma'ani ho sakte hain ke murad zakat se yahan nafs ko shirk-o-kufr ke mail kuchail se pak karna ho. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qad aflaha man zakkaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 9), jis ne apne nafs ko pak kar liya us ne falah pa li. Aur jis ne ise kharab kar liya woh namurad hua. Yahi ek qaul aayat (Wa wailul-lil-mushrikin) (Surah Fussilat: 6) mein bhi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat mein dono zakatein ek sath murad li jayen. Yani zakat-e-nafs bhi aur zakat-e-maal bhi. Filwaqia momin-e-kamil wahi hai jo apne nafs ko bhi pak rakhe aur apne maal ki bhi zakat de wallahu a'lam. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh siwaye apni biwiyon aur malkiyat ki laundiyon ke dusri aurton se apne nafs ko door rakhte hain. Yani haram kari se bachte hain. Zina, liwatat wagairah se apne aap ko bachate hain. Han unki biwiyan jo Allah Ta'ala ne un par halal ki hain aur jihad mein mili hui laundiyan jo un par halal hain. Un ke sath milne mein un par koi malamat aur haraj nahin.

Jo shakhs un ke siwa dusre tariqon se ya kisi dusre se khwahish puri kare woh had se guzar jane wala hai. Qatada R.H farmate hain ke ek aurat ne apne ghulam ko le liya aur apni sanad mein yahi aayat pesh ki. Jab Hazrat Umar R.A ko yeh maloom hua toh aap ne sahaba ke samne is mamle ko pesh kiya. Sahaba ne farmaya is ne ghalat ma'ani murad liye. Is par Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne us ghulam ka sar mundwa kar jalawatan kar diya aur us aurat se farmaya is ke baad tu har musalman par haram hai, lekin yeh asar munqata hai. Aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne ise Surah Ma'idah ki tafsir ke shuru mein warid kiya hai lekin is ke warid karne ki mauzoon jagah yahi thi. Ise aam musalmanon par haram karne ki wajah us ke irade ke khilaf us ke sath mamla karna tha wallahu a'alam. Imam Shafi R.H aur un ke muwafiqeen ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai apne hath se apna khas pani nikal dalna haram hai kyunke yeh bhi in dono halal suraton ke alawa hai aur musht-zani karne wala shakhs bhi had se aage guzar jane wala hai. Imam Hasan bin Arfa ne apne mashhoor juz mein ek hadith warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain saat qisam ke log hain jin ki taraf Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga aur na unhein pak kare ga aur na unhein aalimon ke sath jama kare ga aur unhein sab se pehle jahannam mein jane walon ke sath jahannam mein dakhil kare ga yeh aur baat hai ke woh tauba kar lein tauba karne walon par Allah Ta'ala meherbani se ruju farmata hai ek toh hath se nikah karne wala yani musht-zani karne wala aur aghlam bazi karne aur karane wala. Aur nashe baz sharab ka aadi aur apne maa baap ko marne peetne wala yahan tak ke woh cheekh pukar karne lagein aur apne padosiyon ko eeza pahunchane wala yahan tak ke woh us par la'nat bhejne lage aur apni padosan se badkari karne wala. Lekin is mein ek rawi majhool hai. Wallahu a'alam. Aur wasf hai ke woh apni amanatein aur apne wade pure karte hain amanat mein khayanat nahin karte balkay amanat ki adaigi mein sabqat karte hain wade pure karte hain is ke khilaf aadatein munafiqon ki hoti hain. Rasool ﷺ farmate hain ke munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain: 001 Jab baat kare, jhoot bole 002 Jab wada kare khilaf kare 003 Jab amanat diya jaye khayanat kare. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh namazon ki un auqat par hifazat karte hain. Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob amal Allah ke nazdeek kya hai? Aap ne farmaya namaz ko waqt par ada karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya maa baap se husn-e-sulook karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya Allah ke rah mein jihad karna (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain waqt, ruku, sajda waghera ki hifazat murad hai. In aayaton par dobara nazar dalo. Shuru mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua aur aakhir mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua. Jis se sabit hua ke namaz sab se afzal hai hadith-e-shareef mein hai seedhe seedhe raho aur tum hargiz ihata na kar sakoge. Jaan lo ke tumhare tamam a'amal mein behtareen amal namaz hai.

Dekho wuzu ki hifazat sirf momin hi kar sakta hai. In sab sifaat ko bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke yehi log waris hain jo Jannat-ul-Firdous ke daimi waris honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai Allah se jab mango Jannat-ul-Firdous mango, woh sab se aala aur ausat jannat hai. Wahin se sab nehren jaari hoti hain isi ke oopar Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain tum mein har ek ki do do jaghein hain. Ek manzil jannat mein ek jahannam mein, jab koi dozakh mein gaya to uski manzil ke waris jannati bante hain. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jannati to apni jannat ki jagah sanwar leta hai aur jahannam ki jagah dha deta hai. Aur dozakhi uske khilaf karta hai, kuffar jo ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye thay, unhon ne ibadat tark kardi to unke liye jo inamaat thay woh un se cheen kar sachay mominon ke hawalay kar diye gaye. Isi liye unhein waris kaha gaya. Sahih Muslim mein hai kuch musalman paharon ke barabar gunah le kar aayenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara par daal de ga aur unhein bakhash de ga. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har musalman ko ek ek Yahoodi ya Nasrani de ga ke yeh tera fidiya hai, jahannam se. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab yeh hadith suni to rawi-e-hadith Abu Burdah (R.A) ko qasam di unhon ne teen martaba qasam kha kar hadith ko dohra diya. Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi hai (Tilkal jannatul lati noorisu min ibadina man kana taqiyya) (Surah Maryam: 63). Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi (Wa tilkal jannatul lati uristumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 72). Firdous Roomi zaban mein baagh ko kehte hain baaz salaf kehte ke is baagh ko jis mein angoor ki beilen hon. Wallahu A'lam.

Jis se sabit hua ke namaz sab se afzal hai hadith-e-shareef mein hai seedhe seedhe raho aur tum hargiz ihata na kar sakoge. Jaan lo ke tumhare tamam a'amal mein behtareen amal namaz hai.

Dekho wuzu ki hifazat sirf momin hi kar sakta hai. In sab sifaat ko bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke yehi log waris hain jo Jannat-ul-Firdous ke daimi waris honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai Allah se jab mango Jannat-ul-Firdous mango, woh sab se aala aur ausat jannat hai. Wahin se sab nehren jaari hoti hain isi ke oopar Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain tum mein har ek ki do do jaghein hain. Ek manzil jannat mein ek jahannam mein, jab koi dozakh mein gaya to uski manzil ke waris jannati bante hain. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jannati to apni jannat ki jagah sanwar leta hai aur jahannam ki jagah dha deta hai. Aur dozakhi uske khilaf karta hai, kuffar jo ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye thay, unhon ne ibadat tark kardi to unke liye jo inamaat thay woh un se cheen kar sachay mominon ke hawalay kar diye gaye. Isi liye unhein waris kaha gaya. Sahih Muslim mein hai kuch musalman paharon ke barabar gunah le kar aayenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara par daal de ga aur unhein bakhash de ga. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har musalman ko ek ek Yahoodi ya Nasrani de ga ke yeh tera fidiya hai, jahannam se. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab yeh hadith suni to rawi-e-hadith Abu Burdah (R.A) ko qasam di unhon ne teen martaba qasam kha kar hadith ko dohra diya. Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi hai (Tilkal jannatul lati noorisu min ibadina man kana taqiyya) (Surah Maryam: 63). Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi (Wa tilkal jannatul lati uristumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 72). Firdous Roomi zaban mein baagh ko kehte hain baaz salaf kehte ke is baagh ko jis mein angoor ki beilen hon. Wallahu A'lam.

Das aayatein aur jannat ki zamanat. Nasai, Tirmidhi aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Hazrat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab wahi utarti toh ek aisi meethi meethi, bheeni bheeni, halki halki si aawaz aap ke paas suni jaati jaise shehad ki makkhiyon ke udne ki bhanbhanahat ki hoti hai. Ek martaba yahi halat tari hui. Thodi der ke baad jab wahi utar chuki toh aap ne Qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar apne dono haath utha kar yeh dua padhi ke Aye Allah tu hamein zyada kar, kam na kar, hamara ikram kar, ihanat na kar, hamein inaam ata farma, mehroom na rakh, hamein dusron ke muqable mein fazeelat de, hum par dusron ko pasand na farma, hum se khush ho ja aur hamein khush kar de. Arabi ke alfaaz yeh hain. Dua: (Allahumma zidna wala tanqusna wa akrimna wala tuhinna wa a'tina wala tahrimna wa athirna wala tu'thir 'alaina wardha 'anna wardhina). Phir farmaya mujh par das aayatein utri hain, jo in par jam gaya woh Jannati ho gaya. Phir aap ne mandarja bala das aayatein tilawat farmayin. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) is hadith ko munkar batate hain, kyunke is ka rawi sirf Yunus bin Saleem hai jo muhaddiseen ke nazdeek maroof nahin. Nasai mein hai Hazrat-e-Aisha (R.A) se An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aadat-o-akhlaq ki babat sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khulq Quran tha, phir in aayaton ki (Yuhafizoon) tak tilawat farmayi. Aur farmaya yahi Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke akhlaq thay. Marwi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Jannat-e-Adan paida ki aur is mein darakht waghera apne haath se lagaye toh ise dekh kar farmaya kuch bol. Is ne yahi aayatein tilawat keen jo Quran mein nazil huin. Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain ke is ki ek eent sone ki aur dusri chandi ki hai. Farishtay is mein jab dakhil hue, kehne lage wah wah yeh toh badshahon ki jagah hai. Aur riwayat mein hai is ka gara mushk ka tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is mein woh woh cheezein hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhein, na kisi dil mein samayin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jannat ne jab in aayaton ki tilawat ki toh Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya mujhe apni buzurgi aur jalal ki qasam tujh mein bakheel hargiz dakhil nahin ho sakta. Aur hadith mein hai ke is ki ek eent safed moti ki hai aur dusri surkh yaqoot ki aur teesri sabz zabarjad ki. Is ka gara mushk ka hai is ki ghaas zafran hai. Is riwayat ke aakhir mein hai ke is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat (Wa man yuuqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ula-ika humul muflihoon) (59. Al-Hashr: 9) padhi. Al-gharaz farman hai ke momin murad ko pahunch gaye, woh sa'adat pa gaye, unhon ne nijat pa li. In mominon ki shaan yeh hai ke woh apni namazon mein Allah ka khauf rakhte hain khushoo aur sukoon ke sath namaz ada karte hain. Dil hazir rakhte hain, nigahain neechi hoti hain, bazu jhuke hue hote hain. Muhammad bin Sireen (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle apni nigahain aasman ki taraf uthate thay. Lekin is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad un ki nigahain neechi ho gayin, sajde ki jagah se apni nigah nahin hatate thay.

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke jaye namaz se idhar udhar unki nazar nahin jati thi agar kisi ko is ke siwa aadat pad gayi ho to use chahiye ke apni nigahain neechi kar le. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle aisa kiya karte the. Pas yeh khuzu-o-khushu usi shakhs ko hasil ho sakta hai, jis ka dil farigh ho, khuloos hasil ho aur namaz mein poori dilchaspi ho aur tamam kamon se zyada isi mein dil lagta ho. Chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein hai Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe khushbu aur auratein zyada pasand hain aur meri aankhon ki thandak namaz mein rakh di gayi hai (Nasa'i). Ek Ansari sahabi (R.A) ne namaz ke waqt apni laundi se kaha ke pani lao, namaz padh kar rahat hasil karoon to sunne walon ko unki yeh baat garan guzri. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se farmate the. Ae Bilal utho aur namaz ke sath hamain rahat pahunchao. Mominon ke ausaf phir aur wasf bayan hua ke woh batil, shirk, gunah aur har ek behuda aur be-faida qaul-o-amal se bachte hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Waza marru billaghwi marru kirama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 72) woh laghw baat se buzurgana guzar jate hain woh burai aur be-sud kamon se Allah Ta'ala ki rok ki wajah se ruk jate hain. Aur unka yeh wasf hai ke yeh maal ki zakat ada karte hain. Aksar mufassireen yahi farmate hain lekin is mein ek baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai aur zakat ki farziyat hijrat ke dusre saal mein hoti hai phir Makki aayat mein iska bayan kaise? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke asal zakat to Makkah mein wajib ho chuki thi han is ki miqdar, maal ka nisab wagairah yeh sab ahkam Madine mein muqarrar hue. Dekhiye Surah An'am bhi Makki hai aur is mein yahi zakat ka hukm majood hai aayat (Wa aatu haqqahu yauma hasadihi wala tusrifu) (Surah Al-An'am: 141) yani kheti ke katne wale din is ki zakat ada kar diya karo. Han yeh bhi ma'ani ho sakte hain ke murad zakat se yahan nafs ko shirk-o-kufr ke mail kuchail se pak karna ho. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qad aflaha man zakkaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 9), jis ne apne nafs ko pak kar liya us ne falah pa li. Aur jis ne ise kharab kar liya woh namurad hua. Yahi ek qaul aayat (Wa wailul-lil-mushrikin) (Surah Fussilat: 6) mein bhi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat mein dono zakatein ek sath murad li jayen. Yani zakat-e-nafs bhi aur zakat-e-maal bhi. Filwaqia momin-e-kamil wahi hai jo apne nafs ko bhi pak rakhe aur apne maal ki bhi zakat de wallahu a'lam. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh siwaye apni biwiyon aur malkiyat ki laundiyon ke dusri aurton se apne nafs ko door rakhte hain. Yani haram kari se bachte hain. Zina, liwatat wagairah se apne aap ko bachate hain. Han unki biwiyan jo Allah Ta'ala ne un par halal ki hain aur jihad mein mili hui laundiyan jo un par halal hain. Un ke sath milne mein un par koi malamat aur haraj nahin.

Is par Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne us ghulam ka sar mundwa kar jalawatan kar diya aur us aurat se farmaya is ke baad tu har musalman par haram hai, lekin yeh asar munqata hai. Aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne ise Surah Ma'idah ki tafsir ke shuru mein warid kiya hai lekin is ke warid karne ki mauzoon jagah yahi thi. Ise aam musalmanon par haram karne ki wajah us ke irade ke khilaf us ke sath mamla karna tha wallahu a'alam. Imam Shafi R.H aur un ke muwafiqeen ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai apne hath se apna khas pani nikal dalna haram hai kyunke yeh bhi in dono halal suraton ke alawa hai aur musht-zani karne wala shakhs bhi had se aage guzar jane wala hai. Imam Hasan bin Arfa ne apne mashhoor juz mein ek hadith warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain saat qisam ke log hain jin ki taraf Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga aur na unhein pak kare ga aur na unhein aalimon ke sath jama kare ga aur unhein sab se pehle jahannam mein jane walon ke sath jahannam mein dakhil kare ga yeh aur baat hai ke woh tauba kar lein tauba karne walon par Allah Ta'ala meherbani se ruju farmata hai ek toh hath se nikah karne wala yani musht-zani karne wala aur aghlam bazi karne aur karane wala. Aur nashe baz sharab ka aadi aur apne maa baap ko marne peetne wala yahan tak ke woh cheekh pukar karne lagein aur apne padosiyon ko eeza pahunchane wala yahan tak ke woh us par la'nat bhejne lage aur apni padosan se badkari karne wala. Lekin is mein ek rawi majhool hai. Wallahu a'alam. Aur wasf hai ke woh apni amanatein aur apne wade pure karte hain amanat mein khayanat nahin karte balkay amanat ki adaigi mein sabqat karte hain wade pure karte hain is ke khilaf aadatein munafiqon ki hoti hain. Rasool ﷺ farmate hain ke munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain: 001 Jab baat kare, jhoot bole 002 Jab wada kare khilaf kare 003 Jab amanat diya jaye khayanat kare. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh namazon ki un auqat par hifazat karte hain. Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob amal Allah ke nazdeek kya hai? Aap ne farmaya namaz ko waqt par ada karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya maa baap se husn-e-sulook karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya Allah ke rah mein jihad karna (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain waqt, ruku, sajda waghera ki hifazat murad hai. In aayaton par dobara nazar dalo. Shuru mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua aur aakhir mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua. Jis se sabit hua ke namaz sab se afzal hai hadith-e-shareef mein hai seedhe seedhe raho aur tum hargiz ihata na kar sakoge. Jaan lo ke tumhare tamam a'amal mein behtareen amal namaz hai.

Dekho wuzu ki hifazat sirf momin hi kar sakta hai. In sab sifaat ko bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke yehi log waris hain jo Jannat-ul-Firdous ke daimi waris honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai Allah se jab mango Jannat-ul-Firdous mango, woh sab se aala aur ausat jannat hai. Wahin se sab nehren jaari hoti hain isi ke oopar Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain tum mein har ek ki do do jaghein hain. Ek manzil jannat mein ek jahannam mein, jab koi dozakh mein gaya to uski manzil ke waris jannati bante hain. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jannati to apni jannat ki jagah sanwar leta hai aur jahannam ki jagah dha deta hai. Aur dozakhi uske khilaf karta hai, kuffar jo ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye thay, unhon ne ibadat tark kardi to unke liye jo inamaat thay woh un se cheen kar sachay mominon ke hawalay kar diye gaye. Isi liye unhein waris kaha gaya. Sahih Muslim mein hai kuch musalman paharon ke barabar gunah le kar aayenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara par daal de ga aur unhein bakhash de ga. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har musalman ko ek ek Yahoodi ya Nasrani de ga ke yeh tera fidiya hai, jahannam se. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab yeh hadith suni to rawi-e-hadith Abu Burdah (R.A) ko qasam di unhon ne teen martaba qasam kha kar hadith ko dohra diya. Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi hai (Tilkal jannatul lati noorisu min ibadina man kana taqiyya) (Surah Maryam: 63). Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi (Wa tilkal jannatul lati uristumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 72). Firdous Roomi zaban mein baagh ko kehte hain baaz salaf kehte ke is baagh ko jis mein angoor ki beilen hon. Wallahu A'lam.

Das aayatein aur jannat ki zamanat. Nasai, Tirmidhi aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Hazrat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab wahi utarti toh ek aisi meethi meethi, bheeni bheeni, halki halki si aawaz aap ke paas suni jaati jaise shehad ki makkhiyon ke udne ki bhanbhanahat ki hoti hai. Ek martaba yahi halat tari hui. Thodi der ke baad jab wahi utar chuki toh aap ne Qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar apne dono haath utha kar yeh dua padhi ke Aye Allah tu hamein zyada kar, kam na kar, hamara ikram kar, ihanat na kar, hamein inaam ata farma, mehroom na rakh, hamein dusron ke muqable mein fazeelat de, hum par dusron ko pasand na farma, hum se khush ho ja aur hamein khush kar de. Arabi ke alfaaz yeh hain. Dua: (Allahumma zidna wala tanqusna wa akrimna wala tuhinna wa a'tina wala tahrimna wa athirna wala tu'thir 'alaina wardha 'anna wardhina). Phir farmaya mujh par das aayatein utri hain, jo in par jam gaya woh Jannati ho gaya. Phir aap ne mandarja bala das aayatein tilawat farmayin. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) is hadith ko munkar batate hain, kyunke is ka rawi sirf Yunus bin Saleem hai jo muhaddiseen ke nazdeek maroof nahin. Nasai mein hai Hazrat-e-Aisha (R.A) se An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aadat-o-akhlaq ki babat sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khulq Quran tha, phir in aayaton ki (Yuhafizoon) tak tilawat farmayi. Aur farmaya yahi Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke akhlaq thay. Marwi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Jannat-e-Adan paida ki aur is mein darakht waghera apne haath se lagaye toh ise dekh kar farmaya kuch bol. Is ne yahi aayatein tilawat keen jo Quran mein nazil huin. Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain ke is ki ek eent sone ki aur dusri chandi ki hai. Farishtay is mein jab dakhil hue, kehne lage wah wah yeh toh badshahon ki jagah hai. Aur riwayat mein hai is ka gara mushk ka tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is mein woh woh cheezein hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhein, na kisi dil mein samayin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jannat ne jab in aayaton ki tilawat ki toh Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya mujhe apni buzurgi aur jalal ki qasam tujh mein bakheel hargiz dakhil nahin ho sakta. Is riwayat ke aakhir mein hai ke is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat (Wa man yuuqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ula-ika humul muflihoon) (59. Al-Hashr: 9) padhi. Al-gharaz farman hai ke momin murad ko pahunch gaye, woh sa'adat pa gaye, unhon ne nijat pa li. In mominon ki shaan yeh hai ke woh apni namazon mein Allah ka khauf rakhte hain khushoo aur sukoon ke sath namaz ada karte hain. Dil hazir rakhte hain, nigahain neechi hoti hain, bazu jhuke hue hote hain. Muhammad bin Sireen (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle apni nigahain aasman ki taraf uthate thay. Lekin is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad un ki nigahain neechi ho gayin, sajde ki jagah se apni nigah nahin hatate thay.

Pas yeh khuzu-o-khushu usi shakhs ko hasil ho sakta hai, jis ka dil farigh ho, khuloos hasil ho aur namaz mein poori dilchaspi ho aur tamam kamon se zyada isi mein dil lagta ho. Chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein hai Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe khushbu aur auratein zyada pasand hain aur meri aankhon ki thandak namaz mein rakh di gayi hai (Nasa'i). Ek Ansari sahabi (R.A) ne namaz ke waqt apni laundi se kaha ke pani lao, namaz padh kar rahat hasil karoon to sunne walon ko unki yeh baat garan guzri. Mominon ke ausaf phir aur wasf bayan hua ke woh batil, shirk, gunah aur har ek behuda aur be-faida qaul-o-amal se bachte hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Waza marru billaghwi marru kirama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 72) woh laghw baat se buzurgana guzar jate hain woh burai aur be-sud kamon se Allah Ta'ala ki rok ki wajah se ruk jate hain. Aur unka yeh wasf hai ke yeh maal ki zakat ada karte hain. Aksar mufassireen yahi farmate hain lekin is mein ek baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai aur zakat ki farziyat hijrat ke dusre saal mein hoti hai phir Makki aayat mein iska bayan kaise? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke asal zakat to Makkah mein wajib ho chuki thi han is ki miqdar, maal ka nisab wagairah yeh sab ahkam Madine mein muqarrar hue. Han yeh bhi ma'ani ho sakte hain ke murad zakat se yahan nafs ko shirk-o-kufr ke mail kuchail se pak karna ho. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qad aflaha man zakkaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 9), jis ne apne nafs ko pak kar liya us ne falah pa li. Aur jis ne ise kharab kar liya woh namurad hua. Yahi ek qaul aayat (Wa wailul-lil-mushrikin) (Surah Fussilat: 6) mein bhi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat mein dono zakatein ek sath murad li jayen. Yani zakat-e-nafs bhi aur zakat-e-maal bhi. Filwaqia momin-e-kamil wahi hai jo apne nafs ko bhi pak rakhe aur apne maal ki bhi zakat de wallahu a'lam. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh siwaye apni biwiyon aur malkiyat ki laundiyon ke dusri aurton se apne nafs ko door rakhte hain. Yani haram kari se bachte hain. Zina, liwatat wagairah se apne aap ko bachate hain. Han unki biwiyan jo Allah Ta'ala ne un par halal ki hain aur jihad mein mili hui laundiyan jo un par halal hain. Un ke sath milne mein un par koi malamat aur haraj nahin.

Jaise farman hai aayat (Waza marru billaghwi marru kirama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 72) woh laghw baat se buzurgana guzar jate hain woh burai aur be-sud kamon se Allah Ta'ala ki rok ki wajah se ruk jate hain. Aur unka yeh wasf hai ke yeh maal ki zakat ada karte hain. Aksar mufassireen yahi farmate hain lekin is mein ek baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai aur zakat ki farziyat hijrat ke dusre saal mein hoti hai phir Makki aayat mein iska bayan kaise? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke asal zakat to Makkah mein wajib ho chuki thi han is ki miqdar, maal ka nisab wagairah yeh sab ahkam Madine mein muqarrar hue. Dekhiye Surah An'am bhi Makki hai aur is mein yahi zakat ka hukm majood hai aayat (Wa aatu haqqahu yauma hasadihi wala tusrifu) (Surah Al-An'am: 141) yani kheti ke katne wale din is ki zakat ada kar diya karo. Han yeh bhi ma'ani ho sakte hain ke murad zakat se yahan nafs ko shirk-o-kufr ke mail kuchail se pak karna ho. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qad aflaha man zakkaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 9), jis ne apne nafs ko pak kar liya us ne falah pa li. Aur jis ne ise kharab kar liya woh namurad hua. Yahi ek qaul aayat (Wa wailul-lil-mushrikin) (Surah Fussilat: 6) mein bhi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat mein dono zakatein ek sath murad li jayen. Yani zakat-e-nafs bhi aur zakat-e-maal bhi. Filwaqia momin-e-kamil wahi hai jo apne nafs ko bhi pak rakhe aur apne maal ki bhi zakat de wallahu a'lam. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh siwaye apni biwiyon aur malkiyat ki laundiyon ke dusri aurton se apne nafs ko door rakhte hain. Yani haram kari se bachte hain. Zina, liwatat wagairah se apne aap ko bachate hain. Han unki biwiyan jo Allah Ta'ala ne un par halal ki hain aur jihad mein mili hui laundiyan jo un par halal hain. Un ke sath milne mein un par koi malamat aur haraj nahin.

Jo shakhs un ke siwa dusre tariqon se ya kisi dusre se khwahish puri kare woh had se guzar jane wala hai. Qatada R.H farmate hain ke ek aurat ne apne ghulam ko le liya aur apni sanad mein yahi aayat pesh ki. Jab Hazrat Umar R.A ko yeh maloom hua toh aap ne sahaba ke samne is mamle ko pesh kiya. Sahaba ne farmaya is ne ghalat ma'ani murad liye. Is par Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne us ghulam ka sar mundwa kar jalawatan kar diya aur us aurat se farmaya is ke baad tu har musalman par haram hai, lekin yeh asar munqata hai. Aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne ise Surah Ma'idah ki tafsir ke shuru mein warid kiya hai lekin is ke warid karne ki mauzoon jagah yahi thi. Ise aam musalmanon par haram karne ki wajah us ke irade ke khilaf us ke sath mamla karna tha wallahu a'alam. Imam Shafi R.H aur un ke muwafiqeen ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai apne hath se apna khas pani nikal dalna haram hai kyunke yeh bhi in dono halal suraton ke alawa hai aur musht-zani karne wala shakhs bhi had se aage guzar jane wala hai. Imam Hasan bin Arfa ne apne mashhoor juz mein ek hadith warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain saat qisam ke log hain jin ki taraf Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga aur na unhein pak kare ga aur na unhein aalimon ke sath jama kare ga aur unhein sab se pehle jahannam mein jane walon ke sath jahannam mein dakhil kare ga yeh aur baat hai ke woh tauba kar lein tauba karne walon par Allah Ta'ala meherbani se ruju farmata hai ek toh hath se nikah karne wala yani musht-zani karne wala aur aghlam bazi karne aur karane wala. Aur nashe baz sharab ka aadi aur apne maa baap ko marne peetne wala yahan tak ke woh cheekh pukar karne lagein aur apne padosiyon ko eeza pahunchane wala yahan tak ke woh us par la'nat bhejne lage aur apni padosan se badkari karne wala. Lekin is mein ek rawi majhool hai. Wallahu a'alam. Aur wasf hai ke woh apni amanatein aur apne wade pure karte hain amanat mein khayanat nahin karte balkay amanat ki adaigi mein sabqat karte hain wade pure karte hain is ke khilaf aadatein munafiqon ki hoti hain. Rasool ﷺ farmate hain ke munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain: 001 Jab baat kare, jhoot bole 002 Jab wada kare khilaf kare 003 Jab amanat diya jaye khayanat kare. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh namazon ki un auqat par hifazat karte hain. Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob amal Allah ke nazdeek kya hai? Aap ne farmaya namaz ko waqt par ada karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya maa baap se husn-e-sulook karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya Allah ke rah mein jihad karna (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain waqt, ruku, sajda waghera ki hifazat murad hai. In aayaton par dobara nazar dalo. Shuru mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua aur aakhir mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua. Jis se sabit hua ke namaz sab se afzal hai hadith-e-shareef mein hai seedhe seedhe raho aur tum hargiz ihata na kar sakoge. Jaan lo ke tumhare tamam a'amal mein behtareen amal namaz hai.

Dekho wuzu ki hifazat sirf momin hi kar sakta hai. In sab sifaat ko bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke yehi log waris hain jo Jannat-ul-Firdous ke daimi waris honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai Allah se jab mango Jannat-ul-Firdous mango, woh sab se aala aur ausat jannat hai. Wahin se sab nehren jaari hoti hain isi ke oopar Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain tum mein har ek ki do do jaghein hain. Ek manzil jannat mein ek jahannam mein, jab koi dozakh mein gaya to uski manzil ke waris jannati bante hain. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jannati to apni jannat ki jagah sanwar leta hai aur jahannam ki jagah dha deta hai. Aur dozakhi uske khilaf karta hai, kuffar jo ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye thay, unhon ne ibadat tark kardi to unke liye jo inamaat thay woh un se cheen kar sachay mominon ke hawalay kar diye gaye. Isi liye unhein waris kaha gaya. Sahih Muslim mein hai kuch musalman paharon ke barabar gunah le kar aayenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara par daal de ga aur unhein bakhash de ga. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har musalman ko ek ek Yahoodi ya Nasrani de ga ke yeh tera fidiya hai, jahannam se. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab yeh hadith suni to rawi-e-hadith Abu Burdah (R.A) ko qasam di unhon ne teen martaba qasam kha kar hadith ko dohra diya. Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi hai (Tilkal jannatul lati noorisu min ibadina man kana taqiyya) (Surah Maryam: 63). Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi (Wa tilkal jannatul lati uristumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 72). Firdous Roomi zaban mein baagh ko kehte hain baaz salaf kehte ke is baagh ko jis mein angoor ki beilen hon. Wallahu A'lam.

Das aayatein aur jannat ki zamanat. Nasai, Tirmidhi aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Hazrat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab wahi utarti toh ek aisi meethi meethi, bheeni bheeni, halki halki si aawaz aap ke paas suni jaati jaise shehad ki makkhiyon ke udne ki bhanbhanahat ki hoti hai. Ek martaba yahi halat tari hui. Thodi der ke baad jab wahi utar chuki toh aap ne Qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar apne dono haath utha kar yeh dua padhi ke Aye Allah tu hamein zyada kar, kam na kar, hamara ikram kar, ihanat na kar, hamein inaam ata farma, mehroom na rakh, hamein dusron ke muqable mein fazeelat de, hum par dusron ko pasand na farma, hum se khush ho ja aur hamein khush kar de. Arabi ke alfaaz yeh hain. Dua: (Allahumma zidna wala tanqusna wa akrimna wala tuhinna wa a'tina wala tahrimna wa athirna wala tu'thir 'alaina wardha 'anna wardhina). Phir farmaya mujh par das aayatein utri hain, jo in par jam gaya woh Jannati ho gaya. Phir aap ne mandarja bala das aayatein tilawat farmayin. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) is hadith ko munkar batate hain, kyunke is ka rawi sirf Yunus bin Saleem hai jo muhaddiseen ke nazdeek maroof nahin. Nasai mein hai Hazrat-e-Aisha (R.A) se An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aadat-o-akhlaq ki babat sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khulq Quran tha, phir in aayaton ki (Yuhafizoon) tak tilawat farmayi. Aur farmaya yahi Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke akhlaq thay. Marwi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Jannat-e-Adan paida ki aur is mein darakht waghera apne haath se lagaye toh ise dekh kar farmaya kuch bol. Is ne yahi aayatein tilawat keen jo Quran mein nazil huin. Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain ke is ki ek eent sone ki aur dusri chandi ki hai. Farishtay is mein jab dakhil hue, kehne lage wah wah yeh toh badshahon ki jagah hai. Aur riwayat mein hai is ka gara mushk ka tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is mein woh woh cheezein hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhein, na kisi dil mein samayin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jannat ne jab in aayaton ki tilawat ki toh Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya mujhe apni buzurgi aur jalal ki qasam tujh mein bakheel hargiz dakhil nahin ho sakta. Aur hadith mein hai ke is ki ek eent safed moti ki hai aur dusri surkh yaqoot ki aur teesri sabz zabarjad ki. Is ka gara mushk ka hai is ki ghaas zafran hai. Is riwayat ke aakhir mein hai ke is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat (Wa man yuuqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ula-ika humul muflihoon) (59. Al-Hashr: 9) padhi. Al-gharaz farman hai ke momin murad ko pahunch gaye, woh sa'adat pa gaye, unhon ne nijat pa li. In mominon ki shaan yeh hai ke woh apni namazon mein Allah ka khauf rakhte hain khushoo aur sukoon ke sath namaz ada karte hain. Dil hazir rakhte hain, nigahain neechi hoti hain, bazu jhuke hue hote hain. Muhammad bin Sireen (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle apni nigahain aasman ki taraf uthate thay. Lekin is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad un ki nigahain neechi ho gayin, sajde ki jagah se apni nigah nahin hatate thay.

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke jaye namaz se idhar udhar unki nazar nahin jati thi agar kisi ko is ke siwa aadat pad gayi ho to use chahiye ke apni nigahain neechi kar le. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jannat ne jab in aayaton ki tilawat ki toh Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya mujhe apni buzurgi aur jalal ki qasam tujh mein bakheel hargiz dakhil nahin ho sakta. Aur hadith mein hai ke is ki ek eent safed moti ki hai aur dusri surkh yaqoot ki aur teesri sabz zabarjad ki. Is ka gara mushk ka hai is ki ghaas zafran hai. Is riwayat ke aakhir mein hai ke is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat (Wa man yuuqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ula-ika humul muflihoon) (59. Al-Hashr: 9) padhi. Al-gharaz farman hai ke momin murad ko pahunch gaye, woh sa'adat pa gaye, unhon ne nijat pa li. In mominon ki shaan yeh hai ke woh apni namazon mein Allah ka khauf rakhte hain khushoo aur sukoon ke sath namaz ada karte hain. Dil hazir rakhte hain, nigahain neechi hoti hain, bazu jhuke hue hote hain. Muhammad bin Sireen (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle apni nigahain aasman ki taraf uthate thay. Lekin is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad un ki nigahain neechi ho gayin, sajde ki jagah se apni nigah nahin hatate thay.

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke jaye namaz se idhar udhar unki nazar nahin jati thi agar kisi ko is ke siwa aadat pad gayi ho to use chahiye ke apni nigahain neechi kar le. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle aisa kiya karte the. Pas yeh khuzu-o-khushu usi shakhs ko hasil ho sakta hai, jis ka dil farigh ho, khuloos hasil ho aur namaz mein poori dilchaspi ho aur tamam kamon se zyada isi mein dil lagta ho. Chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein hai Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe khushbu aur auratein zyada pasand hain aur meri aankhon ki thandak namaz mein rakh di gayi hai (Nasa'i). Ek Ansari sahabi (R.A) ne namaz ke waqt apni laundi se kaha ke pani lao, namaz padh kar rahat hasil karoon to sunne walon ko unki yeh baat garan guzri. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se farmate the. Ae Bilal utho aur namaz ke sath hamain rahat pahunchao. Mominon ke ausaf phir aur wasf bayan hua ke woh batil, shirk, gunah aur har ek behuda aur be-faida qaul-o-amal se bachte hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Waza marru billaghwi marru kirama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 72) woh laghw baat se buzurgana guzar jate hain woh burai aur be-sud kamon se Allah Ta'ala ki rok ki wajah se ruk jate hain. Aur unka yeh wasf hai ke yeh maal ki zakat ada karte hain. Aksar mufassireen yahi farmate hain lekin is mein ek baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai aur zakat ki farziyat hijrat ke dusre saal mein hoti hai phir Makki aayat mein iska bayan kaise? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke asal zakat to Makkah mein wajib ho chuki thi han is ki miqdar, maal ka nisab wagairah yeh sab ahkam Madine mein muqarrar hue. Dekhiye Surah An'am bhi Makki hai aur is mein yahi zakat ka hukm majood hai aayat (Wa aatu haqqahu yauma hasadihi wala tusrifu) (Surah Al-An'am: 141) yani kheti ke katne wale din is ki zakat ada kar diya karo. Han yeh bhi ma'ani ho sakte hain ke murad zakat se yahan nafs ko shirk-o-kufr ke mail kuchail se pak karna ho. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qad aflaha man zakkaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 9), jis ne apne nafs ko pak kar liya us ne falah pa li. Aur jis ne ise kharab kar liya woh namurad hua. Yahi ek qaul aayat (Wa wailul-lil-mushrikin) (Surah Fussilat: 6) mein bhi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat mein dono zakatein ek sath murad li jayen. Yani zakat-e-nafs bhi aur zakat-e-maal bhi. Filwaqia momin-e-kamil wahi hai jo apne nafs ko bhi pak rakhe aur apne maal ki bhi zakat de wallahu a'lam. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh siwaye apni biwiyon aur malkiyat ki laundiyon ke dusri aurton se apne nafs ko door rakhte hain. Yani haram kari se bachte hain. Zina, liwatat wagairah se apne aap ko bachate hain. Han unki biwiyan jo Allah Ta'ala ne un par halal ki hain aur jihad mein mili hui laundiyan jo un par halal hain. Un ke sath milne mein un par koi malamat aur haraj nahin.

Jo shakhs un ke siwa dusre tariqon se ya kisi dusre se khwahish puri kare woh had se guzar jane wala hai. Qatada R.H farmate hain ke ek aurat ne apne ghulam ko le liya aur apni sanad mein yahi aayat pesh ki. Jab Hazrat Umar R.A ko yeh maloom hua toh aap ne sahaba ke samne is mamle ko pesh kiya. Sahaba ne farmaya is ne ghalat ma'ani murad liye. Is par Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne us ghulam ka sar mundwa kar jalawatan kar diya aur us aurat se farmaya is ke baad tu har musalman par haram hai, lekin yeh asar munqata hai. Aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne ise Surah Ma'idah ki tafsir ke shuru mein warid kiya hai lekin is ke warid karne ki mauzoon jagah yahi thi. Ise aam musalmanon par haram karne ki wajah us ke irade ke khilaf us ke sath mamla karna tha wallahu a'alam. Imam Shafi R.H aur un ke muwafiqeen ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai apne hath se apna khas pani nikal dalna haram hai kyunke yeh bhi in dono halal suraton ke alawa hai aur musht-zani karne wala shakhs bhi had se aage guzar jane wala hai. Aur nashe baz sharab ka aadi aur apne maa baap ko marne peetne wala yahan tak ke woh cheekh pukar karne lagein aur apne padosiyon ko eeza pahunchane wala yahan tak ke woh us par la'nat bhejne lage aur apni padosan se badkari karne wala. Lekin is mein ek rawi majhool hai. Wallahu a'alam. Aur wasf hai ke woh apni amanatein aur apne wade pure karte hain amanat mein khayanat nahin karte balkay amanat ki adaigi mein sabqat karte hain wade pure karte hain is ke khilaf aadatein munafiqon ki hoti hain. Rasool ﷺ farmate hain ke munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain: 001 Jab baat kare, jhoot bole 002 Jab wada kare khilaf kare 003 Jab amanat diya jaye khayanat kare. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh namazon ki un auqat par hifazat karte hain. Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob amal Allah ke nazdeek kya hai? Aap ne farmaya namaz ko waqt par ada karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya maa baap se husn-e-sulook karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya Allah ke rah mein jihad karna (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain waqt, ruku, sajda waghera ki hifazat murad hai. In aayaton par dobara nazar dalo. Shuru mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua aur aakhir mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua. Jis se sabit hua ke namaz sab se afzal hai hadith-e-shareef mein hai seedhe seedhe raho aur tum hargiz ihata na kar sakoge. Jaan lo ke tumhare tamam a'amal mein behtareen amal namaz hai.

Dekho wuzu ki hifazat sirf momin hi kar sakta hai. In sab sifaat ko bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke yehi log waris hain jo Jannat-ul-Firdous ke daimi waris honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai Allah se jab mango Jannat-ul-Firdous mango, woh sab se aala aur ausat jannat hai. Wahin se sab nehren jaari hoti hain isi ke oopar Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain tum mein har ek ki do do jaghein hain. Aur dozakhi uske khilaf karta hai, kuffar jo ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye thay, unhon ne ibadat tark kardi to unke liye jo inamaat thay woh un se cheen kar sachay mominon ke hawalay kar diye gaye. Isi liye unhein waris kaha gaya. Sahih Muslim mein hai kuch musalman paharon ke barabar gunah le kar aayenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara par daal de ga aur unhein bakhash de ga. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har musalman ko ek ek Yahoodi ya Nasrani de ga ke yeh tera fidiya hai, jahannam se. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab yeh hadith suni to rawi-e-hadith Abu Burdah (R.A) ko qasam di unhon ne teen martaba qasam kha kar hadith ko dohra diya. Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi hai (Tilkal jannatul lati noorisu min ibadina man kana taqiyya) (Surah Maryam: 63). Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi (Wa tilkal jannatul lati uristumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 72). Firdous Roomi zaban mein baagh ko kehte hain baaz salaf kehte ke is baagh ko jis mein angoor ki beilen hon. Wallahu A'lam.

Das aayatein aur jannat ki zamanat. Nasai, Tirmidhi aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Hazrat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab wahi utarti toh ek aisi meethi meethi, bheeni bheeni, halki halki si aawaz aap ke paas suni jaati jaise shehad ki makkhiyon ke udne ki bhanbhanahat ki hoti hai. Ek martaba yahi halat tari hui. Thodi der ke baad jab wahi utar chuki toh aap ne Qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar apne dono haath utha kar yeh dua padhi ke Aye Allah tu hamein zyada kar, kam na kar, hamara ikram kar, ihanat na kar, hamein inaam ata farma, mehroom na rakh, hamein dusron ke muqable mein fazeelat de, hum par dusron ko pasand na farma, hum se khush ho ja aur hamein khush kar de. Arabi ke alfaaz yeh hain. Dua: (Allahumma zidna wala tanqusna wa akrimna wala tuhinna wa a'tina wala tahrimna wa athirna wala tu'thir 'alaina wardha 'anna wardhina). Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi (Wa tilkal jannatul lati uristumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 72). Firdous Roomi zaban mein baagh ko kehte hain baaz salaf kehte ke is baagh ko jis mein angoor ki beilen hon. Wallahu A'lam.

Das aayatein aur jannat ki zamanat. Nasai, Tirmidhi aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein marwi hai ke Hazrat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jab wahi utarti toh ek aisi meethi meethi, bheeni bheeni, halki halki si aawaz aap ke paas suni jaati jaise shehad ki makkhiyon ke udne ki bhanbhanahat ki hoti hai. Ek martaba yahi halat tari hui. Thodi der ke baad jab wahi utar chuki toh aap ne Qibla ki taraf mutawajja ho kar apne dono haath utha kar yeh dua padhi ke Aye Allah tu hamein zyada kar, kam na kar, hamara ikram kar, ihanat na kar, hamein inaam ata farma, mehroom na rakh, hamein dusron ke muqable mein fazeelat de, hum par dusron ko pasand na farma, hum se khush ho ja aur hamein khush kar de. Arabi ke alfaaz yeh hain. Dua: (Allahumma zidna wala tanqusna wa akrimna wala tuhinna wa a'tina wala tahrimna wa athirna wala tu'thir 'alaina wardha 'anna wardhina). Phir farmaya mujh par das aayatein utri hain, jo in par jam gaya woh Jannati ho gaya. Phir aap ne mandarja bala das aayatein tilawat farmayin. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) is hadith ko munkar batate hain, kyunke is ka rawi sirf Yunus bin Saleem hai jo muhaddiseen ke nazdeek maroof nahin. Nasai mein hai Hazrat-e-Aisha (R.A) se An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aadat-o-akhlaq ki babat sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khulq Quran tha, phir in aayaton ki (Yuhafizoon) tak tilawat farmayi. Aur farmaya yahi Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke akhlaq thay. Marwi hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Jannat-e-Adan paida ki aur is mein darakht waghera apne haath se lagaye toh ise dekh kar farmaya kuch bol. Is ne yahi aayatein tilawat keen jo Quran mein nazil huin. Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain ke is ki ek eent sone ki aur dusri chandi ki hai. Farishtay is mein jab dakhil hue, kehne lage wah wah yeh toh badshahon ki jagah hai. Aur riwayat mein hai is ka gara mushk ka tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke is mein woh woh cheezein hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhein, na kisi dil mein samayin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Jannat ne jab in aayaton ki tilawat ki toh Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya mujhe apni buzurgi aur jalal ki qasam tujh mein bakheel hargiz dakhil nahin ho sakta. Aur hadith mein hai ke is ki ek eent safed moti ki hai aur dusri surkh yaqoot ki aur teesri sabz zabarjad ki. Is ka gara mushk ka hai is ki ghaas zafran hai. Is riwayat ke aakhir mein hai ke is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat (Wa man yuuqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ula-ika humul muflihoon) (59. Al-Hashr: 9) padhi. Al-gharaz farman hai ke momin murad ko pahunch gaye, woh sa'adat pa gaye, unhon ne nijat pa li. In mominon ki shaan yeh hai ke woh apni namazon mein Allah ka khauf rakhte hain khushoo aur sukoon ke sath namaz ada karte hain. Dil hazir rakhte hain, nigahain neechi hoti hain, bazu jhuke hue hote hain. Muhammad bin Sireen (R.H) ka qaul hai ke Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle apni nigahain aasman ki taraf uthate thay. Lekin is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad un ki nigahain neechi ho gayin, sajde ki jagah se apni nigah nahin hatate thay.

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke jaye namaz se idhar udhar unki nazar nahin jati thi agar kisi ko is ke siwa aadat pad gayi ho to use chahiye ke apni nigahain neechi kar le. Ek mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi is aayat ke nazil hone se pehle aisa kiya karte the. Pas yeh khuzu-o-khushu usi shakhs ko hasil ho sakta hai, jis ka dil farigh ho, khuloos hasil ho aur namaz mein poori dilchaspi ho aur tamam kamon se zyada isi mein dil lagta ho. Chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein hai Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe khushbu aur auratein zyada pasand hain aur meri aankhon ki thandak namaz mein rakh di gayi hai (Nasa'i). Ek Ansari sahabi (R.A) ne namaz ke waqt apni laundi se kaha ke pani lao, namaz padh kar rahat hasil karoon to sunne walon ko unki yeh baat garan guzri. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se farmate the. Ae Bilal utho aur namaz ke sath hamain rahat pahunchao. Mominon ke ausaf phir aur wasf bayan hua ke woh batil, shirk, gunah aur har ek behuda aur be-faida qaul-o-amal se bachte hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Waza marru billaghwi marru kirama) (Surah Al-Furqan: 72) woh laghw baat se buzurgana guzar jate hain woh burai aur be-sud kamon se Allah Ta'ala ki rok ki wajah se ruk jate hain. Aur unka yeh wasf hai ke yeh maal ki zakat ada karte hain. Aksar mufassireen yahi farmate hain lekin is mein ek baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai aur zakat ki farziyat hijrat ke dusre saal mein hoti hai phir Makki aayat mein iska bayan kaise? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke asal zakat to Makkah mein wajib ho chuki thi han is ki miqdar, maal ka nisab wagairah yeh sab ahkam Madine mein muqarrar hue. Dekhiye Surah An'am bhi Makki hai aur is mein yahi zakat ka hukm majood hai aayat (Wa aatu haqqahu yauma hasadihi wala tusrifu) (Surah Al-An'am: 141) yani kheti ke katne wale din is ki zakat ada kar diya karo. Han yeh bhi ma'ani ho sakte hain ke murad zakat se yahan nafs ko shirk-o-kufr ke mail kuchail se pak karna ho. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qad aflaha man zakkaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 9), jis ne apne nafs ko pak kar liya us ne falah pa li. Aur jis ne ise kharab kar liya woh namurad hua. Yahi ek qaul aayat (Wa wailul-lil-mushrikin) (Surah Fussilat: 6) mein bhi hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat mein dono zakatein ek sath murad li jayen. Yani zakat-e-nafs bhi aur zakat-e-maal bhi. Filwaqia momin-e-kamil wahi hai jo apne nafs ko bhi pak rakhe aur apne maal ki bhi zakat de wallahu a'lam. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh siwaye apni biwiyon aur malkiyat ki laundiyon ke dusri aurton se apne nafs ko door rakhte hain. Yani haram kari se bachte hain. Zina, liwatat wagairah se apne aap ko bachate hain. Han unki biwiyan jo Allah Ta'ala ne un par halal ki hain aur jihad mein mili hui laundiyan jo un par halal hain. Un ke sath milne mein un par koi malamat aur haraj nahin.

Jo shakhs un ke siwa dusre tariqon se ya kisi dusre se khwahish puri kare woh had se guzar jane wala hai. Qatada R.H farmate hain ke ek aurat ne apne ghulam ko le liya aur apni sanad mein yahi aayat pesh ki. Jab Hazrat Umar R.A ko yeh maloom hua toh aap ne sahaba ke samne is mamle ko pesh kiya. Sahaba ne farmaya is ne ghalat ma'ani murad liye. Is par Farooq-e-Azam R.A ne us ghulam ka sar mundwa kar jalawatan kar diya aur us aurat se farmaya is ke baad tu har musalman par haram hai, lekin yeh asar munqata hai. Aur sath hi ghareeb bhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne ise Surah Ma'idah ki tafsir ke shuru mein warid kiya hai lekin is ke warid karne ki mauzoon jagah yahi thi. Ise aam musalmanon par haram karne ki wajah us ke irade ke khilaf us ke sath mamla karna tha wallahu a'alam. Imam Shafi R.H aur un ke muwafiqeen ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai apne hath se apna khas pani nikal dalna haram hai kyunke yeh bhi in dono halal suraton ke alawa hai aur musht-zani karne wala shakhs bhi had se aage guzar jane wala hai. Imam Hasan bin Arfa ne apne mashhoor juz mein ek hadith warid ki hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain saat qisam ke log hain jin ki taraf Allah Ta'ala nazar-e-rahmat se na dekhe ga aur na unhein pak kare ga aur na unhein aalimon ke sath jama kare ga aur unhein sab se pehle jahannam mein jane walon ke sath jahannam mein dakhil kare ga yeh aur baat hai ke woh tauba kar lein tauba karne walon par Allah Ta'ala meherbani se ruju farmata hai ek toh hath se nikah karne wala yani musht-zani karne wala aur aghlam bazi karne aur karane wala. Aur nashe baz sharab ka aadi aur apne maa baap ko marne peetne wala yahan tak ke woh cheekh pukar karne lagein aur apne padosiyon ko eeza pahunchane wala yahan tak ke woh us par la'nat bhejne lage aur apni padosan se badkari karne wala. Lekin is mein ek rawi majhool hai. Wallahu a'alam. Aur wasf hai ke woh apni amanatein aur apne wade pure karte hain amanat mein khayanat nahin karte balkay amanat ki adaigi mein sabqat karte hain wade pure karte hain is ke khilaf aadatein munafiqon ki hoti hain. Rasool ﷺ farmate hain ke munafiq ki teen nishaniyan hain: 001 Jab baat kare, jhoot bole 002 Jab wada kare khilaf kare 003 Jab amanat diya jaye khayanat kare. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh namazon ki un auqat par hifazat karte hain. Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob amal Allah ke nazdeek kya hai? Aap ne farmaya namaz ko waqt par ada karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya maa baap se husn-e-sulook karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya Allah ke rah mein jihad karna (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain waqt, ruku, sajda waghera ki hifazat murad hai. In aayaton par dobara nazar dalo. Shuru mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua aur aakhir mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua. Jis se sabit hua ke namaz sab se afzal hai hadith-e-shareef mein hai seedhe seedhe raho aur tum hargiz ihata na kar sakoge. Jaan lo ke tumhare tamam a'amal mein behtareen amal namaz hai.

Dekho wuzu ki hifazat sirf momin hi kar sakta hai. In sab sifaat ko bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke yehi log waris hain jo Jannat-ul-Firdous ke daimi waris honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai Allah se jab mango Jannat-ul-Firdous mango, woh sab se aala aur ausat jannat hai. Wahin se sab nehren jaari hoti hain isi ke oopar Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain tum mein har ek ki do do jaghein hain. Ek manzil jannat mein ek jahannam mein, jab koi dozakh mein gaya to uski manzil ke waris jannati bante hain. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jannati to apni jannat ki jagah sanwar leta hai aur jahannam ki jagah dha deta hai. Aur dozakhi uske khilaf karta hai, kuffar jo ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye thay, unhon ne ibadat tark kardi to unke liye jo inamaat thay woh un se cheen kar sachay mominon ke hawalay kar diye gaye. Isi liye unhein waris kaha gaya. Sahih Muslim mein hai kuch musalman paharon ke barabar gunah le kar aayenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara par daal de ga aur unhein bakhash de ga. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har musalman ko ek ek Yahoodi ya Nasrani de ga ke yeh tera fidiya hai, jahannam se. Phir aur wasf bayan farmaya ke woh namazon ki un auqat par hifazat karte hain. Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob amal Allah ke nazdeek kya hai? Aap ne farmaya namaz ko waqt par ada karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya maa baap se husn-e-sulook karna. Pucha gaya phir? Farmaya Allah ke rah mein jihad karna (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Hazrat Qatada R.H farmate hain waqt, ruku, sajda waghera ki hifazat murad hai. In aayaton par dobara nazar dalo. Shuru mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua aur aakhir mein bhi namaz ka bayan hua. Jis se sabit hua ke namaz sab se afzal hai hadith-e-shareef mein hai seedhe seedhe raho aur tum hargiz ihata na kar sakoge. Jaan lo ke tumhare tamam a'amal mein behtareen amal namaz hai.

Dekho wuzu ki hifazat sirf momin hi kar sakta hai. In sab sifaat ko bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke yehi log waris hain jo Jannat-ul-Firdous ke daimi waris honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai Allah se jab mango Jannat-ul-Firdous mango, woh sab se aala aur ausat jannat hai. Wahin se sab nehren jaari hoti hain isi ke oopar Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Farmate hain tum mein har ek ki do do jaghein hain. Ek manzil jannat mein ek jahannam mein, jab koi dozakh mein gaya to uski manzil ke waris jannati bante hain. Isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jannati to apni jannat ki jagah sanwar leta hai aur jahannam ki jagah dha deta hai. Aur dozakhi uske khilaf karta hai, kuffar jo ibadat ke liye paida kiye gaye thay, unhon ne ibadat tark kardi to unke liye jo inamaat thay woh un se cheen kar sachay mominon ke hawalay kar diye gaye. Isi liye unhein waris kaha gaya. Sahih Muslim mein hai kuch musalman paharon ke barabar gunah le kar aayenge, jinhein Allah Ta'ala Yahood-o-Nasara par daal de ga aur unhein bakhash de ga. Aur sanad se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala har musalman ko ek ek Yahoodi ya Nasrani de ga ke yeh tera fidiya hai, jahannam se. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab yeh hadith suni to rawi-e-hadith Abu Burdah (R.A) ko qasam di unhon ne teen martaba qasam kha kar hadith ko dohra diya. Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi hai (Tilkal jannatul lati noorisu min ibadina man kana taqiyya) (Surah Maryam: 63). Isi jaisi aayat yeh bhi (Wa tilkal jannatul lati uristumooha bima kuntum ta'maloon) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 72). Firdous Roomi zaban mein baagh ko kehte hain baaz salaf kehte ke is baagh ko jis mein angoor ki beilen hon. Wallahu A'lam.

Insaan ki paidaish marhala-war Allah Ta'ala insani paidaish ki ibtida bayan karta hai ke asal Adam mitti se hain, jo keechad ki aur bajne wali mitti ki surat mein thi phir Hazrat Adam A.S ke pani se unki aulad paida hui. Jaise farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein mitti se paida karke phir insaan banakar zameen par phailadiya hai. Musnad mein Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam A.S ko khak ki ek mutthi se paida kiya, jise tamam zameen par se liya tha. Pas isi aitbar se aulad-e-Adam ke rang roop mukhtalif hue, koi surkh hai, koi safed hai, koi siyah hai, koi aur rang ka hai. In mein nek hain aur bad bhi hain. Ayat (Summa ja'alnahu) mein zameer ka marja jins-e-insan ki taraf hai jaise irshad hai ayat (ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّاۗءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ ۚ) (Surah As-Sajdah: 8). Aur ayat mein hai (اَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُّمْ مِّنْ مَّاۗءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ) (Surah Al-Mursalat: 20). Pas insaan ke liye ek muddat-e-mu'ayyan tak uski maa ka raham hi thikana hota hai jahan ek halat se dusri halat ki taraf aur ek surat se dusri surat ki taraf muntaqil hota rehta hai. Phir nutfay ki jo ek uchalne wala pani hai jo mard ki peeth se aurat ke seenay se nikalta hai shakl badal kar surkh rang ki boti ki shakl mein badal jata hai phir use gosht ke ek tukray ki surat mein badal diya jata hai jis mein koi shakl aur koi khat nahin hota. Phir in mein haddiyan banadein sar hath paon haddi rag pathay waghera banaye aur peeth ki haddi banayi. Rasool ﷺ farmate hain insaan ka tamam jism sad gal jata hai siwaye reedh ki haddi ke. Isi se paida kiya jata hai aur isi se tarkeeb di jati hai. Phir in haddiyon ko woh gosht pehnata hai taake woh posheeda aur qawi rahein. Phir is mein rooh phoonkta hai jis se woh hilne julne chalne phirne ke qabil hojaye aur ek jandar insaan ban jaye. Dekhne ki sunne ki samajhne ki aur harkat-o-sukoon ki qudrat ata farmata hai. Woh babarkat Allah sab se achi paidaish ka paida karne wala hai. Hazrat Ali R.A se marwi hai ke jab nutfay par char mahinay guzar jate hain to Allah Ta'ala ek farishtay ko bhejta hai jo teen teen andheriyon mein is mein rooh phoonkta hai yahi ma'ani hai ke hum phir use dusri hi paidaish mein paida karte hain yani dusri qisam ki is paidaish se murad rooh ka phoonka jana hai pas ek halat se dusri aur dusri se teesri ki taraf maa ke pet mein hi her-pher hone ke baad bilkul nasamajh bacha paida hota hai phir woh barhta jata hai yahan tak ke jawan ban jata hai phir adher-pan aata hai phir burha hojata hai phir bilkul hi budha hojata hai. Al-gharaz rooh ka phoonka jana phir in ke inqilabat ka aana shuru hojata hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Sadiq-o-Masduq Aan-Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) farmate hain ke tum mein se har ek ki paidaish chalees din tak us ki maa ke pet mein jama hoti hai phir chalees din tak khoon-e-basta ki surat mein rehta hai phir chalees din tak woh gosht ke lothray ki shakal mein rehta hai phir Allah Ta'ala farishtay ko bhejta hai jo is mein rooh phoonkta hai aur ba-hukm-e-Ilahi chaar baatein likh li jaati hain: rozi, ajal, amal, aur nek ya bad, bura ya bhala hona. Pas qasam hai us ki jis ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin ke ek shakhs jannati amal karta rehta hai yahan tak ke jannat se ek haath door reh jata hai lekin taqdeer ka woh likha ghalib aa jata hai aur khatmay ke waqt dozakhi kaam karne lagta hai aur isi par marta hai aur jahannam raseed hota hai. Isi tarah ek insaan buray kaam karte karte dozakh se haath bhar ke faaslay par reh jata hai lekin phir taqdeer ka likha aagay barh jata hai aur jannat ke aamaal par khatma ho kar dakhil-e-firdous-e-bareen ho jata hai. (Bukhari-o-Muslim waghaira). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain nutfa jab raham mein parta hai to woh har har baal aur naakhun ki jagah pahunch jata hai phir chalees din ke baad us ki shakal jamay huay khoon jaisi ho jati hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) apne as-haab se baatein bayan kar rahe thay ke ek Yahoodi aa gaya to kuffar-e-Quraish ne us se kaha yeh nubuwwat ke da'wedar hain. Us ne kaha achha main in se ek sawaal karta hoon jisay nabiyon ke siwa aur koi nahin jaanta. Aap (ﷺ) ki majlis mein aa kar baith kar poochta hai ke batao insaan ki paidaish kis cheez se hoti hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya mard aurat ke nutfay se. Mard ka nutfa ghaleez aur gaarha hota hai is se haddiyan aur pattay bantay hain aur aurat ka nutfa raqeeq aur patla hota hai is se gosht aur khoon banta hai. Us ne kaha aap sachay hain, aglay nabiyon ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain jab nutfay ko raham mein chalees din guzar jatay hain to ek farishta aata hai aur woh Allah Ta'ala se daryaft karta hai ke Aye Allah! Yeh nek hoga ya bad? Mard hoga ya aurat? Jo jawab milta hai woh likh leta hai aur amal, umar, aur narmi garmi sab kuch likh leta hai phir daftar lapet liya jata hai is mein phir kisi kami beshi ki gunjaish nahin rehti. Bazzar ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne raham par ek farishta muqarrar kiya hai jo arz karta hai Aye Allah! Ab nutfa hai, Aye Allah! Ab lothra hai, Aye Allah! Ab gosht ka tukra hai. Jab Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala usay paida karna chahta hai woh poochta hai Aye Allah! Mard ho ya aurat, shaqi ho ya sa'eed? Rizq kya hai? Ajal kya hai? Is ka jawab diya jata hai aur yeh sab cheezein likh li jaati hain. In sab baaton aur itni kaamil qudraton ko bayan farma kar farmaya ke sab se achi paidaish karne wala Allah barkaton wala hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain main ne apne Rab ki muwafiqat chaar baaton mein ki hai, jab yeh aayat utri ke hum ne insaan ko bajti mitti se paida kiya hai to besakhta meri zabaan se "Fatabarak Allahu Ahsanul Khaliqeen" nikla aur wahi phir utra.

Zaid bin Thabit Ansari (R.A) jab Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko oopar wali aayatein likhwa rahe thay aur aayat (ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنٰهُ خَلْقًا اٰخَرَ ۭفَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحْسَنُ الْخٰلِقِيْنَ 14؀ۭ) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 14) tak likhwa chuke toh Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ne daryaft farmaya: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap kaise hanse? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is aayat ke khatmay par bhi yahi hai. Is hadith ki sanad ka ek raawi Jabir Ju'fi hai jo bahut hi za'eef hai aur yeh riwayat bilkul munkar hai. Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) katib-e-wahi Madine mein thay na ke Makka mein. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ke Islam ka waqiya bhi Madine ka waqiya hai aur yeh aayat Makka mein nazil hui hai, pas mandaraja-bala riwayat bilkul munkar hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is pehli paidaish ke baad tum marne wale ho, phir Qayamat ke din dusri dafa paida kiye jaoge, phir hisab-kitab hoga, khair-o-shar ka badla milega.

Sadiq-o-Masduq Aan-Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) farmate hain ke tum mein se har ek ki paidaish chalees din tak us ki maa ke pet mein jama hoti hai phir chalees din tak khoon-e-basta ki surat mein rehta hai phir chalees din tak woh gosht ke lothray ki shakal mein rehta hai phir Allah Ta'ala farishtay ko bhejta hai jo is mein rooh phoonkta hai aur ba-hukm-e-Ilahi chaar baatein likh li jaati hain: rozi, ajal, amal, aur nek ya bad, bura ya bhala hona. Pas qasam hai us ki jis ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin ke ek shakhs jannati amal karta rehta hai yahan tak ke jannat se ek haath door reh jata hai lekin taqdeer ka woh likha ghalib aa jata hai aur khatmay ke waqt dozakhi kaam karne lagta hai aur isi par marta hai aur jahannam raseed hota hai. Isi tarah ek insaan buray kaam karte karte dozakh se haath bhar ke faaslay par reh jata hai lekin phir taqdeer ka likha aagay barh jata hai aur jannat ke aamaal par khatma ho kar dakhil-e-firdous-e-bareen ho jata hai. (Bukhari-o-Muslim waghaira). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) farmate hain nutfa jab raham mein parta hai to woh har har baal aur naakhun ki jagah pahunch jata hai phir chalees din ke baad us ki shakal jamay huay khoon jaisi ho jati hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) apne as-haab se baatein bayan kar rahe thay ke ek Yahoodi aa gaya to kuffar-e-Quraish ne us se kaha yeh nubuwwat ke da'wedar hain. Us ne kaha achha main in se ek sawaal karta hoon jisay nabiyon ke siwa aur koi nahin jaanta. Aap (ﷺ) ki majlis mein aa kar baith kar poochta hai ke batao insaan ki paidaish kis cheez se hoti hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya mard aurat ke nutfay se. Mard ka nutfa ghaleez aur gaarha hota hai is se haddiyan aur pattay bantay hain aur aurat ka nutfa raqeeq aur patla hota hai is se gosht aur khoon banta hai. Us ne kaha aap sachay hain, aglay nabiyon ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain jab nutfay ko raham mein chalees din guzar jatay hain to ek farishta aata hai aur woh Allah Ta'ala se daryaft karta hai ke Aye Allah! Yeh nek hoga ya bad? Mard hoga ya aurat? Jo jawab milta hai woh likh leta hai aur amal, umar, aur narmi garmi sab kuch likh leta hai phir daftar lapet liya jata hai is mein phir kisi kami beshi ki gunjaish nahin rehti. Bazzar ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne raham par ek farishta muqarrar kiya hai jo arz karta hai Aye Allah! Ab nutfa hai, Aye Allah! Ab lothra hai, Aye Allah! Ab gosht ka tukra hai. Jab Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala usay paida karna chahta hai woh poochta hai Aye Allah! Mard ho ya aurat, shaqi ho ya sa'eed? Rizq kya hai? Ajal kya hai? Is ka jawab diya jata hai aur yeh sab cheezein likh li jaati hain. In sab baaton aur itni kaamil qudraton ko bayan farma kar farmaya ke sab se achi paidaish karne wala Allah barkaton wala hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain main ne apne Rab ki muwafiqat chaar baaton mein ki hai, jab yeh aayat utri ke hum ne insaan ko bajti mitti se paida kiya hai to besakhta meri zabaan se "Fatabarak Allahu Ahsanul Khaliqeen" nikla aur wahi phir utra.

Zaid bin Thabit Ansari (R.A) jab Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko oopar wali aayatein likhwa rahe thay aur aayat (ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنٰهُ خَلْقًا اٰخَرَ ۭفَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحْسَنُ الْخٰلِقِيْنَ 14؀ۭ) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 14) tak likhwa chuke toh Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ne daryaft farmaya: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap kaise hanse? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is aayat ke khatmay par bhi yahi hai. Is hadith ki sanad ka ek raawi Jabir Ju'fi hai jo bahut hi za'eef hai aur yeh riwayat bilkul munkar hai. Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) katib-e-wahi Madine mein thay na ke Makka mein. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ke Islam ka waqiya bhi Madine ka waqiya hai aur yeh aayat Makka mein nazil hui hai, pas mandaraja-bala riwayat bilkul munkar hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is pehli paidaish ke baad tum marne wale ho, phir Qayamat ke din dusri dafa paida kiye jaoge, phir hisab-kitab hoga, khair-o-shar ka badla milega.

Insaan ki paidaish marhala-war Allah Ta'ala insani paidaish ki ibtida bayan karta hai ke asal Adam mitti se hain, jo keechad ki aur bajne wali mitti ki surat mein thi phir Hazrat Adam A.S ke pani se unki aulad paida hui. Jaise farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein mitti se paida karke phir insaan banakar zameen par phailadiya hai. Musnad mein Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam A.S ko khak ki ek mutthi se paida kiya, jise tamam zameen par se liya tha. Pas isi aitbar se aulad-e-Adam ke rang roop mukhtalif hue, koi surkh hai, koi safed hai, koi siyah hai, koi aur rang ka hai. In mein nek hain aur bad bhi hain. Ayat (Summa ja'alnahu) mein zameer ka marja jins-e-insan ki taraf hai jaise irshad hai ayat (ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّاۗءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ ۚ) (Surah As-Sajdah: 8). Aur ayat mein hai (اَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُّمْ مِّنْ مَّاۗءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ) (Surah Al-Mursalat: 20). Pas insaan ke liye ek muddat-e-mu'ayyan tak uski maa ka raham hi thikana hota hai jahan ek halat se dusri halat ki taraf aur ek surat se dusri surat ki taraf muntaqil hota rehta hai. Phir nutfay ki jo ek uchalne wala pani hai jo mard ki peeth se aurat ke seenay se nikalta hai shakl badal kar surkh rang ki boti ki shakl mein badal jata hai phir use gosht ke ek tukray ki surat mein badal diya jata hai jis mein koi shakl aur koi khat nahin hota. Phir in mein haddiyan banadein sar hath paon haddi rag pathay waghera banaye aur peeth ki haddi banayi. Rasool ﷺ farmate hain insaan ka tamam jism sad gal jata hai siwaye reedh ki haddi ke. Isi se paida kiya jata hai aur isi se tarkeeb di jati hai. Phir in haddiyon ko woh gosht pehnata hai taake woh posheeda aur qawi rahein. Phir is mein rooh phoonkta hai jis se woh hilne julne chalne phirne ke qabil hojaye aur ek jandar insaan ban jaye. Dekhne ki sunne ki samajhne ki aur harkat-o-sukoon ki qudrat ata farmata hai. Woh babarkat Allah sab se achi paidaish ka paida karne wala hai. Aasman ki paidaish marhala-war insaan ki paidaish ka zikr karke aasmanon ki paidaish ka bayan ho raha hai jin ki banawat insani banawat se bahut badi bahut bhari aur bahut badi sanat wali hai. Surah Alif Laam Meem Sajdah mein bhi isi ka bayan hai jaise Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Jumma ke din subah ki namaz ki awwal rakat mein padha karte the wahan pehle aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ka zikr hai phir insani paidaish ka bayan hai phir Qayamat ka aur saza jaza ka zikr hai waghera. Saat aasmanon ke banane ka zikr kiya hai jaisa farman hai aayat (تُـسَبِّحُ لَهُ السَّمٰوٰتُ السَّـبْعُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيْهِنَّ 44؀) (17. Al-Isra: 44) saaton aasman aur sab zameenein aur un ki sab cheezein Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh bayan karti hain kya tum nahin dekhte ke Allah Ta'ala ne kis tarah upar tale saaton aasmanon ko banaya hai. Allah Ta'ala woh hai jis ne saat aasman banaye inhi jaisi zameenein bhi. Is ka hukm un ke darmiyan nazil hota hai taake tum jaan lo ke Allah Ta'ala har cheez par qadir hai. Aur tamam cheezon ko apne wasee ilm se ghere hue hai Allah apni makhlooq se ghafil nahin. Jo cheez zameen mein jaye jo zameen se nikle Allah ke ilm mein hai aasman se jo utre aur jo aasman ki taraf chadhe woh jaanta hai jahan bhi tum ho woh tumhare saath hai aur tumhare ek ek amal ko woh dekh raha hai. Aasman ki buland-o-bala cheezein aur zameen ki posheeda cheezein, aur pahadon ki chotiyan, samundaron, maidanon, darakhton ki use khabar hai. Darakhton ka koi patta nahin girta jo us ke ilm mein na ho koi dana zameen ki andheron mein aisa nahin jaata jise woh na jaanta ho koi tar-o-khushk cheez aisi nahin jo khuli kitab mein na ho.

Aasman se nuzool-e-barish Allah Ta'ala ki yun toh beshumar aur anginat ne'matein hain. Lekin chand badi badi ne'maton ka yahan zikr ho raha hai ke woh aasman se ba-qadr-e-hajat-o-zaroorat barish barsata hai. Na toh bahut zyada ke zameen kharab ho jaye aur paidawar gal sad jaye. Na bahut kam ke phal anaaj waghera paida hi na ho. Balkeh is andaze se ke kheti sarsabz rahe, baghaat hare bhare rahein. Hauz, talab, nahrein, nadiyan, naale, darya beh niklein na peene ki kami ho na pilane ki. Yahan tak ke jis jagah zyada barish ki zaroorat hoti hai zyada hoti hai aur jahan kam ki zaroorat hoti hai kam hoti hai aur jahan ki zameen is qabil hi nahin hoti wahan pani nahin barasta lekin nadiyon aur naalon ke zariye wahan qudrat barsati pani pahuncha kar wahan ki zameen ko sairab kar deti hai. Jaise ke Misr ke ilaqe ki zameen jo darya-e-neel ki tari se sarsabz-o-shadab ho jati hai. Isi pani ke sath surkh mitti kheench kar jati hai jo Habsha ke ilaqe mein hoti hai wahan ki barish ke sath mitti beh kar pahunchti hai jo zameen par thehar jati hai aur zameen qabil-e-zira'at ho jati hai warna wahan ki shor zameen kheti baadi ke qabil nahin. SubhanAllah is Lateef-e-Khabeer, is Ghafoor-e-Raheem Allah ki kya kya qudratein aur hikmatein zameen mein Allah pani ko thehra deta hai zameen mein is ko choos lene aur jazb kar lene ki qabiliyat Allah Ta'ala paida kar deta hai taake daanon ko aur guthliyon ko andar hi andar woh pani pahuncha de phir farmata hai hum is ke le jaane aur door kar dene par yani na barsane par bhi qadir hain agar chahein shor, sanglakh zameen, pahadon aur bekar banon mein barsa dein. Agar chahein toh pani ko kadwa kar dein na peene ke qabil rahe na pilane ke, na khet aur baghaat ke matlab ka rahe, na nahane dhone ke maqsad ka. Agar chahein zameen mein woh quwwat hi na rakhein ke woh pani ko jazb kar le choos le balkeh pani upar hi upar tairta phire yeh bhi hamare ikhtiyar mein hai ke aisi door-daraz jheelon mein pani pahuncha dein ke tumhare liye bekar ho jaye aur tum koi faida is se na utha sako. Yeh khaas Allah ka fazl-o-karam aur is ka lutf-o-rahm hai ke woh badalon se meetha umda halka aur khush zaiqa pani barsata hai phir ise zameen mein pahunchata hai aur idhar udhar rail peil kar deta hai khetiyan alag pakti hain baghaat alag tayyar hote hain, khud peete ho apne janwaron ko pilate ho nahate dhote ho pakeezgi aur suthrai hasil karte ho falhamdulillah. Aasmani barish se Rabb-ul-Aalameen tumhare liye roziyan ugata hai, lehlahate hue khet hain, kahin sarsabz bagh hain jo khush-numa aur khush-manzar hone ke ilawa mufeed aur faiz wale hain. Khajoor angoor jo ahl-e-Arab ka dil-pasand mewa hai. Aur isi tarah har mulk walon ke liye alag alag tarah tarah ke meway us ne paida kar diye hain. Jin ke husool ke ewaz Allah ki shukarguzari bhi kisi ke bas ki nahin. Bahut meway tumhein us ne de rakhe hain jin ki khubsurti bhi tum dekhte ho aur un ke zaiqay se bhi kha kar faida uthate ho. Phir zaitoon ke darakht ka zikr farmaya.

Toor-e-Sina woh pahar hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se baat-cheet ki thi aur us ke gird-o-nawah ki pahariyan. Toor us pahar ko kehte hain jo hara aur darakhton wala ho, warna use jabal kahenge, Toor nahin kahenge. Pas Toor-e-Sina mein jo darakht-e-zaitoon paida hota hai us mein se tel nikalta hai jo khane walon ko saalan ka kaam deta hai. Hadith mein hai zaitoon ka tel khao aur lagao, woh mubarak darakht mein se nikalta hai (Ahmad). Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ke yahan ek sahib Ashura ki shab ko mehman ban kar aaye to aap ne unhein oont ki sari aur zaitoon khilaya aur farmaya yeh us mubarak darakht ka tel hai jis ka zikr Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya hai. Chopayon ka zikr ho raha hai aur un se jo fawaid insaan utha rahe hain, un par sawar hote hain, un par apna saman-e-asbab ladte hain aur door-daraz tak pahunchte hain ke yeh na hote to wahan tak pahunchne mein jaan aadhi reh jaati. Beshak Allah Ta'ala bandon par meherbani aur rehmat wala hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Awa lam yarau anna khalaqna lahum mimma amilat aidina an'aman fahum laha malikoon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 71). Kya woh nahin dekhte ke khud hum ne unhein chopayon ka malik bana rakha hai ke yeh un ke gosht khayen, un par sawariyan lein aur tarah tarah ke nafa hasil karein, kya ab bhi un par hamari shukarguzari wajib nahin? Yeh khushki ki sawariyan hain, phir tari ki sawariyan kashti, jahaz waghera alag hain.
