SubhanAllah is Lateef-e-Khabeer, is Ghafoor-e-Raheem Allah ki kya kya qudratein aur hikmatein zameen mein Allah pani ko thehra deta hai zameen mein is ko choos lene aur jazb kar lene ki qabiliyat Allah Ta'ala paida kar deta hai taake daanon ko aur guthliyon ko andar hi andar woh pani pahuncha de phir farmata hai hum is ke le jaane aur door kar dene par yani na barsane par bhi qadir hain agar chahein shor, sanglakh zameen, pahadon aur bekar banon mein barsa dein. Agar chahein toh pani ko kadwa kar dein na peene ke qabil rahe na pilane ke, na khet aur baghaat ke matlab ka rahe, na nahane dhone ke maqsad ka. Agar chahein zameen mein woh quwwat hi na rakhein ke woh pani ko jazb kar le choos le balkeh pani upar hi upar tairta phire yeh bhi hamare ikhtiyar mein hai ke aisi door-daraz jheelon mein pani pahuncha dein ke tumhare liye bekar ho jaye aur tum koi faida is se na utha sako. Yeh khaas Allah ka fazl-o-karam aur is ka lutf-o-rahm hai ke woh badalon se meetha umda halka aur khush zaiqa pani barsata hai phir ise zameen mein pahunchata hai aur idhar udhar rail peil kar deta hai khetiyan alag pakti hain baghaat alag tayyar hote hain, khud peete ho apne janwaron ko pilate ho nahate dhote ho pakeezgi aur suthrai hasil karte ho falhamdulillah. Aasmani barish se Rabb-ul-Aalameen tumhare liye roziyan ugata hai, lehlahate hue khet hain, kahin sarsabz bagh hain jo khush-numa aur khush-manzar hone ke ilawa mufeed aur faiz wale hain. Khajoor angoor jo ahl-e-Arab ka dil-pasand mewa hai. Aur isi tarah har mulk walon ke liye alag alag tarah tarah ke meway us ne paida kar diye hain. Jin ke husool ke ewaz Allah ki shukarguzari bhi kisi ke bas ki nahin. Bahut meway tumhein us ne de rakhe hain jin ki khubsurti bhi tum dekhte ho aur un ke zaiqay se bhi kha kar faida uthate ho. Phir zaitoon ke darakht ka zikr farmaya.

Toor-e-Sina woh pahar hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se baat-cheet ki thi aur us ke gird-o-nawah ki pahariyan. Toor us pahar ko kehte hain jo hara aur darakhton wala ho, warna use jabal kahenge, Toor nahin kahenge. Pas Toor-e-Sina mein jo darakht-e-zaitoon paida hota hai us mein se tel nikalta hai jo khane walon ko saalan ka kaam deta hai. Hadith mein hai zaitoon ka tel khao aur lagao, woh mubarak darakht mein se nikalta hai (Ahmad). Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ke yahan ek sahib Ashura ki shab ko mehman ban kar aaye to aap ne unhein oont ki sari aur zaitoon khilaya aur farmaya yeh us mubarak darakht ka tel hai jis ka zikr Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kiya hai. Chopayon ka zikr ho raha hai aur un se jo fawaid insaan utha rahe hain, un par sawar hote hain, un par apna saman-e-asbab ladte hain aur door-daraz tak pahunchte hain ke yeh na hote to wahan tak pahunchne mein jaan aadhi reh jaati. Beshak Allah Ta'ala bandon par meherbani aur rehmat wala hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Awa lam yarau anna khalaqna lahum mimma amilat aidina an'aman fahum laha malikoon) (Surah Ya-Sin: 71). Kya woh nahin dekhte ke khud hum ne unhein chopayon ka malik bana rakha hai ke yeh un ke gosht khayen, un par sawariyan lein aur tarah tarah ke nafa hasil karein, kya ab bhi un par hamari shukarguzari wajib nahin? Yeh khushki ki sawariyan hain, phir tari ki sawariyan kashti, jahaz waghera alag hain.

Nuh A.S aur mutakabbir wadere. Nuh A.S ko Allah Ta'ala ne Basheer-o-Nazeer bana kar un ki qoum ki taraf mab'oos farmaya. Aap ne un mein ja kar paigham-e-Ilahi pohanchaya ke Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siwa tumhari ibadat ka haqdar koi nahin. Tum Allah ke siwa us ke sath dusron ko poojte hue Allah se darte nahin ho? Qoum ke baron ne aur sardaron ne kaha yeh toh tum jaisa hi ek insaan hai. Nabuwwat ka da'wa kar ke tum se bada banna chahta hai, sardari hasil karne ki fikr mein hai. Bhala insaan ki taraf wahi kaise aati? Allah ka irada nabi bhejne ka hota toh kisi aasmani farishte ko bhej deta. Yeh toh hum ne kya, hamare baap dadon ne bhi nahin suna ke insaan Allah ka rasool ban jaye. Yeh toh koi deewana shakhs hai ke aise da'we karta hai aur deengein marta hai. Achha khamosh raho, dekh lo halak hoga.

Jab Nuh (A.S) un se tang aa gaye aur mayoos ho gaye toh Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke mere Parwardigar main lachar ho gaya hoon meri madad farma. Jhutlane walon par mujhe ghalib kar. Usi waqt farman-e-Ilahi aaya ke kashti banao aur khoob mazboot chauri chakli. Is mein har qisam ka ek ek jora rakh lo, haiwanat, nabatat, phal waghera waghera aur isi mein apne walon ko bhi bitha lo magar jis par Allah ki taraf se halakat sabqat kar chuki hai jo iman nahin laye. Jaise aap ki qoum ke kafir aur aap ka larka aur aap ki biwi. Wallahu A'lam. Aur jab tum azab-e-asmani ba-surat-e-barish aur pani aata dekh lo phir mujh se in zalimon ki sifarish na karna. Phir in par raham na karna na in ke iman ki umeed rakhna. Bas phir toh yeh sab gharq ho jayenge aur kufr par hi in ka khatma hoga. Is ka poora qissa Surah Hud ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai is liye hum nahin dohrate. Jab tu aur tere momin sathi kashti par sawar ho jao toh kehna ke sab tareef Allah hi ke liye hai, jis ne hamain zalimon se nijat di. Jaise farman hai ke Allah ne tumhari sawari ke liye kashtiyan aur chaupaye banaye hain taake tum sawari le kar apne Rab ki nemat ko mano aur sawar ho kar kaho ke woh Allah pak hai jis ne in janwaron ko hamare tabe bana diya hai halanke hum mein khud itni taqat na thi, bil-yaqeen hum apne Rab ki taraf laut kar jane wale hain. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ne yahi kaha aur farmaya aao is mein baith jao Allah ke naam ke sath is ka chalna aur thairna hai. Pas shuru chalne ke waqt bhi Allah ko yaad kiya. Aur jab woh thairne lagi tab bhi Allah ko yaad kiya aur dua ki ke Aye Allah mujhe mubarak manzil par utarna aur Tu hi sab se behtar utarne wala hai. Is mein yani mominon ki nijat aur kafiron ki halakat mein ambiya ki tasdeeq ki nishaniyan hain, Allah ki uluhiyat ki alamatein hain, us ki qudrat us ka ilm is se zahir hota hai. Yaqeenan rasoolon ko bhej kar Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki azmaish aur un ka poora imtehan kar leta hai.

Aad-o-Samood ka tazkirah Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke baad bhi bahut si ummatein aayin jaise Aad jo un ke baad aayi ya Samood qoum jin par cheekh ka azaab aaya tha. Jaise ke is aayat mein hai un mein bhi Allah ke Rasool (A.S) aaye Allah ki ibadat aur us ki tauheed ki taleem di. Lekin unhon ne jhutlaya, mukhalifat ki, itteba se inkar kiya. Mehez is bina par ke yeh insaan hain. Qayamat ko bhi na maana, jismani hashr ke munkir ban gaye aur kehne lage ke yeh bilkul door-az-qiyas hai. Ba'asat-o-Nashr, hashr-o-qayamat koi cheez nahin. Is shakhs ne yeh sab baatein az-khud ghar li hain hum aisi fazool baaton ke maanne wale nahin. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua ki aur un par madad talab ki. Isi waqt jawab mila ke teri namuwafiqat abhi abhi un par azaab ban kar barse gi aur yeh aath aath aansoo royenge. Aakhir ek zabardast cheekh aur be-panah changhaar ke sath sab talaf kar diye gaye aur woh mustahiq bhi isi ke thay. Tez-o-tund aandhi aur poori taqatwar hawa ke sath hi farishtay ki dil dehlane wali khaufnaak aawaz ne unhein para para kar diya woh halak aur tabah ho gaye. Bhoosa ban kar ud gaye. Sirf makanat ke khandhar in gaye guzre hue logon ki nishandahi ke liye reh gaye woh kooday karkat ki tarah na-cheez mehez ho gaye. Aise zalimon ke liye doori hai. Un par Rabb ne zulm nahin kiya balkay unhi ka kiya hua tha jo un ke samne aaya. Pas ae logo! Tumhein bhi Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mukhalifat se darna chahiye.

Aksariyat hamesha badkaron ki rahi. In ke baad bhi bahut si ummatein aur makhlooq aayi jo hamari paida karda thi. Un ki paidaish se pehle un ki ajal jo qudrat ne muqarrar ki thi, use us ne poora kiya na taqdeem hui na takheer. Phir hum ne pay dar pay lagatar rasool bheje. Har ummat mein paighambar aaya us ne logon ko paigham-e-ilahi pahunchaya ke ek Allah ki ibadat karo us ke maswa kisi ki pooja na karo. Ba'az rah-e-rast par aa gaye aur ba'az par kalma-e-azab rast aa gaya. Tamam ummaton ki aksariyat nabiyon ki munkir rahi jaise Surah Yaseen mein farmaya aayat (Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibadi maa ya'teehim mir rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon) (Surah Yaseen: 30) afsos hai bandon par un ke paas jo rasool aaya unhon ne use mazaq mein udaya. Hum ne yakke ba'd deegare sab ko gharat aur fana kar diya aayat (Wa kam ahlaknaa minal qurooni mim ba'di Noohin wa kafaa bi Rabbika bi zunoobi 'ibadihi khabeeram baseera) (Surah Al-Isra: 17) Nooh A.S ke baad bhi hum ne kayi ek bastiyan tabah kar dein. Unhein hum ne purane afsane bana diya woh neest-o-nabood ho gaye aur qisse un ke baqi reh gaye. Be-imano ke liye rahmat se doori hai.

Darya-burd Firaun: Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur un ke bhai Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ko Allah Ta'ala ne Firaun aur qoum-e-Firaun ke paas poori daleelon ke sath aur zabardast mojizon ke sath bheja, lekin unhon ne bhi sabiqah kafiron ki tarah apne nabiyon ki takzeeb-o-mukhalifat ki aur sabiqah kuffar ki tarah yahi kaha ke hum apne jaise insanon ki nabuwwat ke qail nahin. Un ke dil bhi bilkul un jaise hi ho gaye. Bil-akhir ek hi din mein ek sath sab ko Allah Ta'ala ne darya-burd kar diya. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko logon ki hidayat ke liye Taurat mili. Dobara mominon ke hathon kafir halak kiye gaye, jihad ke ahkaam utre. Is tarah aam azab se koi ummat Firaun aur qoum-e-Firaun yani Qibtiyon ke baad halak nahin hui. Ek aur ayat mein farman hai: Guzashta ummaton ki halakat ke baad hum ne Musa (A.S) ko kitab inayat farmayi jo logon ke liye baseerat, hidayat aur rahmat thi, taake woh nasihat hasil karein.

Un ke dil bhi bilkul un jaise hi ho gaye. Bil-akhir ek hi din mein ek sath sab ko Allah Ta'ala ne darya-burd kar diya. Is ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko logon ki hidayat ke liye Taurat mili. Dobara mominon ke hathon kafir halak kiye gaye, jihad ke ahkaam utre. Is tarah aam azab se koi ummat Firaun aur qoum-e-Firaun yani Qibtiyon ke baad halak nahin hui. Ek aur ayat mein farman hai: Guzashta ummaton ki halakat ke baad hum ne Musa (A.S) ko kitab inayat farmayi jo logon ke liye baseerat, hidayat aur rahmat thi, taake woh nasihat hasil karein.

Rabwah ke ma'ani: Hazrat Isa A.S aur Maryam ko Allah ne apni qudrat-e-kamilah ke izhar ki ek zabardast nishani banaya. Adam ko mard-o-aurat ke baghair paida kiya, Hawwa ko sirf mard se baghair aurat ke paida kiya, Isa A.S ko sirf aurat se baghair mard ke paida kiya. Baqiya tamam insanon ko mard-o-aurat se paida kiya. Rabwah kehte hain buland zameen ko jo hari aur paidawar ke qabil ho, woh jagah ghaas pani wali taro-taza aur hari bhari thi. Jahan Allah Ta'ala ne apne is ghulam aur Nabi ko aur unki Siddiqah walida ko jo Allah ki bandi aur londi thin jagah di thi. Woh jaari pani wali saaf suthri hamwar zameen thi. Kehte hain yeh tukda Misr ka tha ya Damishq ka ya Filisteen ka. Rabwah retli zameen ko bhi kehte hain. Chunancha ek bahut hi ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne kisi Sahabi R.A se farmaya tha ke tera inteqal Rabwah mein hoga. Woh retli zameen mein faut hue. In tamam aqwal mein zyada qareeb qaul woh hai ke murad is se nehar hai jaise aur aayat mein is tarah bayan farmaya gaya hai aayat (Qad ja'ala rabbuki tahtaki sariyan) (Surah Maryam: 24) tere Rab ne tere qadmon tale ek jaari nehar baha di hai. Pas yeh maqam Bait-ul-Muqaddas ka maqam hai, toh goya is aayat ki tafseer yeh aayat hai aur Quran ki tafseer awwalan Quran se, phir hadith se, phir aasar se karni chahiye.

Akl-e-Halal ki fazilat. Allah Ta'ala apne tamam Anbiya A.S ko hukum farmata hai ke woh halal luqma khayein aur nek a'amal baja laya karein. Pas sabit hua ke luqma-e-halal amal-e-saliha ka madadgar hai. Pas Anbiya ne sab bhulaiyan jama kar lein, qaul, fe'l, dalalat, nasihat, sab unhon ne samet li. Allah Ta'ala unhein apne sab bandon ki taraf se nek badle de. Yahan koi rangat maza bayan nahin farmaya balkay yeh farmaya ke halal cheezein khao. Hazrat Isa A.S apni walida ke bunne ki ujrat mein se khate thay. Sahih hadith mein hai koi Nabi aisa nahin jis ne bakriyan na charai hon. Logon ne poocha aap samet? Aap ne farmaya haan main bhi chand qirat par ahl-e-Makkah ki bakriyan charaya karta tha. Aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Dawood A.S apne hath ki mehnat ka khaya karte thay. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Allah ko sab se zyada pasand roza Dawood A.S ka roza hai aur sab se zyada pasandida qayam Dawood A.S ka qayam hai. Aadhi raat sote thay aur tihai raat namaz-e-tahajjud parhte thay aur chatha hissa so jate thay aur ek din roza rakhte thay aur ek din na rakhte thay, maidan-e-jang mein kabhi peeth na dikhate. Umm-e-Abdullah bin Shaddad R.A farmati hain main ne Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein doodh ka ek pyala sham ke waqt bheja taake aap us se apna roza iftar karein, din ka aakhri hissa tha aur dhoop ki tezi thi to aap ne qasid ko wapas kar diya, agar teri bakri ka hota to khair aur baat thi. Unhon ne paigham bheja ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne yeh doodh apne maal se khareed kiya hai, phir aap ne pee liya. Dusre din mai sahiba hazir-e-khidmat ho kar arz karti hain ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ is garmi mein main ne doodh bheja, bahut der se bheja tha aap ne mere qasid ko wapas kar diya. Aap ne farmaya haan mujhe yahi farmaya gaya hai. "Anbiya sirf halal khate hain aur sirf nek amal karte hain", aur hadith mein hai aap ne farmaya logo Allah Ta'ala pak hai woh sirf pak ko hi qabool farmata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko bhi wahi hukum diya hai jo Rasool ko diya hai ke ae Rasoolo! Pak cheez khao aur nek kaam karo main tumhare a'amal ka aalim hoon. Yahi hukum iman walon ko diya ke ae imandaro! Jo halal cheezein hum ne tumhein de rakhi hain unhein khao. Phir aap ne ek shakhs ka zikr kiya jo lamba safar karta hai, paraganda baalon wala, ghubar-alood chehre wala hota hai lekin khana pehna haram ka hota hai, woh apne hath aasman ki taraf phaila kar ae Rab! ae Rab! kehta hai lekin namumkin hai ke us ki dua qabool farmai jaye. Imam Tirmidhi R.H is hadith ko Hasan Gharib batlate hain. Phir farmaya ae paighambaro! tumhara yeh deen ek hi deen hai, ek hi millat hai, yani Allah Wahid-o-La-Shareek-lah ki ibadat ki taraf dawat dena. Isi liye isi ke baad farmaya ke main tumhara Rab hoon. Pas mujh se daro. Surah Anbiya mein is ki tafseer-o-tashreeh ho chuki hai, ayat (Ummatan Wahidatan) par nasb-e-haal hone ki wajah hai.

Jin ummaton ki taraf Hazrat Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) bheje gaye thay unhon ne Allah ke deen ke tukray kar diye aur jis gumrahi par ar gaye usi par nazan-o-farhan ho gaye is liye ke apne nazdeek isi ko hidayat samajh baithe. Pas bator daant ke farmaya unhein un ke behakne bhatakne mein hi chhor dijiye yahan tak ke un ki tabahi ka waqt aa jaye. Khane peene dijiye, mast-o-be-khud hone dijiye, abhi abhi maloom ho jaye ga. Kya yeh maghroor yeh guman karte hain ke hum jo maal-o-aulad unhein de rahe hain woh un ki bhalai aur neki ki wajah se un ke sath sulook kar rahe hain? Hargiz nahin. Yeh to unhein dhoka laga hai yeh is se samajh baithe hain ke hum jaise yahan khush-haal hain wahan bhi be-saza reh jayenge yeh mehez ghalat hai jo kuch unhein duniya mein hum de rahe hain woh to sirf zara si der ki mohlat hai lekin yeh be-shaoor hain. Yeh log asal tak pohanche hi nahin. Jaise farman hai. Ayat (FALA TU'JIBKA AMWALUHUM WALA AWLADUHUM INNAMA YURIDULLAHU LIYU'AZZIBAHUM BIHA FIL-HAYATID-DUNYA WA TAZHAQA ANFUSUHUM WAHUM KAFIRUN) (9. At-Tawbah: 55). Tujhe un ke maal-o-aulad dhoke mein na dalein Allah ka irada to yeh hai ke is se unhein duniya mein azab kare. Aur ayat mein hai yeh dheel sirf is liye di gayi hai ke woh apne gunahon mein aur barh jayen. Aur jagah hai. Mujhe aur is baat ke jhutlane walon ko chhor de hum unhein is tarah batadreej pakrenge ke unhein maloom bhi na ho. Aur ayaton mein farmaya hai ayat (ZARNI WAMAN KHALAQTU WAHIDA) (74. Al-Muddaththir: 11), yani mujhe aur use chhor de jis ko main ne tanha paida kiya hai aur ba-kasrat maal diya hai aur hama-waqt majood farzand diye hain aur sab tarah ka saman is liye muhayya kar diya hai phir use hawas hai ke main ise aur zyada doon, hargiz nahin woh hamari baton ka mukhalif hai aur ayat mein hai (WAMA AMWALUKUM WALA AWLADUKUM BILLATI TUQARRIBUKUM 'INDANA ZULFA ILLA MAN AMANA WA 'AMILA SALIHAN FA-ULA'IKA LAHUM JAZA'UD-DI'FI BIMA 'AMILU WAHUM FIL-GHURUFATI AMINUN) (34. Saba: 37). Tumhare maal aur tumhari auladein tumhein mujh se qurbat nahin de saktin mujh se qareeb to woh hai jo imandar aur nek amal ho. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bohat si ayatein hain Hazrat Qatada (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yahi Allah ka shukr hai pas tum insanon ko maal aur aulad se na parakho balkay insan ki kasauti iman aur nek amal hai.

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare akhlaq bhi tum mein isi tarah taqseem kiye hain jis tarah roziyan taqseem farmayi hain. Allah Ta'ala duniya toh use bhi deta hai jis se mohabbat rakhe aur use bhi deta hai jis se mohabbat na rakhe, haan deen sirf usi ko deta hai jis se poori mohabbat rakhta ho. Pas jise Allah deen de samjho ke Allah Ta'ala us se mohabbat rakhta hai. Uss ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jaan hai, banda musalman nahin hota jab tak ke us ka dil aur zaban musalman na hojaye aur banda momin nahin hota jab tak ke us ke padosi us ki ezaon se be-fikr na hojayein. Logon ne poocha ke ezaon se kya murad hai? Farmaya dhoke-bazi, zulm waghera. Suno jo banda haram maal hasil karle us ke kharch mein barkat nahin hoti, us ka sadqa qabool nahin hota, jo chhod kar jata hai woh us ka jahannam ka tosha hota hai. Allah Ta'ala burai ko burai se nahin mitata, haan burai ko bhalai se dafa karta hai. Khabees khabees ko nahin mitata.

Allah Ta'ala unhein apne sab bandon ki taraf se nek badle de. Yahan koi rangat maza bayan nahin farmaya balkay yeh farmaya ke halal cheezein khao. Umm-e-Abdullah bin Shaddad R.A farmati hain main ne Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein doodh ka ek pyala sham ke waqt bheja taake aap us se apna roza iftar karein, din ka aakhri hissa tha aur dhoop ki tezi thi to aap ne qasid ko wapas kar diya, agar teri bakri ka hota to khair aur baat thi. Unhon ne paigham bheja ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ main ne yeh doodh apne maal se khareed kiya hai, phir aap ne pee liya. Dusre din mai sahiba hazir-e-khidmat ho kar arz karti hain ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ is garmi mein main ne doodh bheja, bahut der se bheja tha aap ne mere qasid ko wapas kar diya. Aap ne farmaya haan mujhe yahi farmaya gaya hai. Yahi hukum iman walon ko diya ke ae imandaro! Jo halal cheezein hum ne tumhein de rakhi hain unhein khao. Imam Tirmidhi R.H is hadith ko Hasan Gharib batlate hain. Phir farmaya ae paighambaro! tumhara yeh deen ek hi deen hai, ek hi millat hai, yani Allah Wahid-o-La-Shareek-lah ki ibadat ki taraf dawat dena. Isi liye isi ke baad farmaya ke main tumhara Rab hoon. Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare akhlaq bhi tum mein isi tarah taqseem kiye hain jis tarah roziyan taqseem farmayi hain. Allah Ta'ala duniya toh use bhi deta hai jis se mohabbat rakhe aur use bhi deta hai jis se mohabbat na rakhe, haan deen sirf usi ko deta hai jis se poori mohabbat rakhta ho. Pas jise Allah deen de samjho ke Allah Ta'ala us se mohabbat rakhta hai. Uss ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jaan hai, banda musalman nahin hota jab tak ke us ka dil aur zaban musalman na hojaye aur banda momin nahin hota jab tak ke us ke padosi us ki ezaon se be-fikr na hojayein. Logon ne poocha ke ezaon se kya murad hai? Farmaya dhoke-bazi, zulm waghera. Suno jo banda haram maal hasil karle us ke kharch mein barkat nahin hoti, us ka sadqa qabool nahin hota, jo chhod kar jata hai woh us ka jahannam ka tosha hota hai. Allah Ta'ala burai ko burai se nahin mitata, haan burai ko bhalai se dafa karta hai. Khabees khabees ko nahin mitata.

Hasan (R.H) farmate hain ke momin neki aur khauf-e-Ilahi ka majmua hota hai. Munafiq burai ke sath nidar aur be-khauf hota hai. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki shar'i aur fitri aayat aur nishaniyon par yaqeen rakhte hain jaise Hazrat Maryam (Alaihas Salam) ka wasf bayan hua hai ke woh apne Rab ke kalmaat aur us ki kitabon ka yaqeen rakhti thin, Allah ki qudrat, qaza aur shar' ka unhein kamil yaqeen tha. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke kya yeh woh log hain jin se zina, chori, aur sharab-khwari ho jati hai? Lekin un ke dil mein khauf-e-Ilahi hota hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae Siddiq ki ladki! Yeh nahin, balkeh yeh woh hain jo namazein padhte hain, roze rakhte hain, sadqe karte hain, lekin qabool na hone se darte hain, yahi hain jo nekiyon mein sabqat karte hain (Tirmidhi). Aap ne marhaba kaha aur kaha barabar aate kyun nahin ho? Jawab diya is liye ke kahin aap ko takleef na ho lekin aaj main ek aayat ke alfaaz ki tehqeeq ke liye hazir hua hoon, aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْتُوْنَ مَآ اٰتَوْا وَّقُلُوْبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمْ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ رٰجِعُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 60) hain? Aap ne farmaya phir tum khush ho jao. Wallah main ne isi tarah inhi alfaaz ko padhte hue Rasool (ﷺ) ko suna hai. Is ka ek raawi Ismail bin Muslim Makki za'eef hai. Saaton mashhoor qira'aton aur jamhoor ki qira'at mein wahi hai jo maujooda Quran mein hai aur ma'ani ki ro se bhi zyada zahir yahi maloom hota hai kyunke unhein sabiq qarar diya hai aur agar dusri qira'at ko lein to yeh sabiq nahin balkeh hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Aasan Shariat: Allah Ta'ala ne shariat aasan rakhi hai. Aise ahkaam nahin diye jo insani taqat se kharij hon. Phir Qayamat ke din woh aamaal ka hisab lega jo sab ke sab kitabi surat mein likhe hue maujood honge. Yeh nama-e-aamaal sahih sahih taur par un ka ek ek amal bata de ga. Kisi tarah ka zulm kisi par na kiya jaye ga, koi neki kam na hogi, haan aksar mominon ki buraiyan maaf kar di jayengi. Lekin mushrikon ke dil Quran se behke aur bhatke hue hain. Is ke siwa bhi un ki aur bad-aamaliyan bhi hain jaise shirk waghera jise yeh dharle se kar rahe hain. Taake un ki buraiyan unhein Jahannam se door na rehne dein. Chunancha woh hadith guzar chuki jis mein farman hai ke insaan neki ke kaam karte karte Jannat se sirf haath bhar ke faasle par reh jata hai jo us par taqdeer ka likha ghalib aa jata hai aur bad-aamaliyan shuru kar deta hai, natija yeh hota hai ke Jahannam wasil ho jata hai. Yahan tak ke jab un mein se aasuda-haal daulat-mand logon par azaab-e-Ilahi aa padta hai to ab woh faryad karne lagte hain. Surah Muzzammil mein farman hai ke mujhe aur in maaldaar jhutlane walon ko chhod dijiye, inhein kuch mohlat aur dijiye, hamare paas beriyan bhi hain aur Jahannam bhi hai aur gale mein atakne wala khana hai aur dardnaak saza hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadau wa lata hina manas) (Surah Sad: 3) yani hum ne in se pehle aur bhi bahut si bastiyon ko tabah kar diya, us waqt unhon ne wawela shuru ki jab ke woh mehez besood thi. Yahan farmata hai aaj tum kyun shor macha rahe ho? Kyun faryad kar rahe ho? Koi bhi tumhein aaj kaam nahin aa sakta, tum par azaab-e-Ilahi aa pade, ab cheekhna chillana sab besood hai. Kaun hai jo mere azaabon ke muqable mein tumhari madad kar sake? Phir un ka ek bada gunah bayan ho raha hai ke yeh meri aayaton ke munkir the, inhein sunte the aur taal jate the, bulaye jate the lekin inkaar kar dete the, tauheed ka inkaar karte the, shirk par aqeeda rakhte the. Haq to buland-o-bartar Allah hi ka chalta hai. Mustakbireen daal hai un ke haq se hatne aur haq ka inkaar karne se. Aayat hai ke yeh us waqt takabbur karte the aur haq aur ahl-e-haq ko haqeer samajhte the. Is maani ki ro se 'beh' ke zameer ka marja ya to Haram hai yani Makkah, ke yeh is mein behuda bakwaas bakte the. Ya Quran hai jise yeh mazaq mein udate the, kabhi shayari kehte the, kabhi kahanat waghera. Ya khud Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain ke raaton ko bekaar baithe hue apni gap-shab mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko kabhi shayar kehte, kabhi kaahin kehte, kabhi jaadugar kehte, kabhi jhoota kehte, kabhi majnoon batlate. Halanke Haram Allah ka ghar hai, Quran Allah ka kalaam hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ke Rasool hain jinhein Allah ne apni madad pahunchai aur Makkah par qabiz kiya. In mushrikeen ko wahan se zaleel-o-past karke nikala.

Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad yeh hai ke yeh log Baitullah ki wajah se fakhr karte thay aur khayal karte thay ke woh Auliya-e-Allah hain halankeh yeh khayal mehez weham tha. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke mushrikeen-e-Quraish Baitullah par fakhr karte thay, apne aap ko iska mohtamim aur mutawalli batlate thay halankeh na ise abad karte thay na iska sahih adab karte thay. Imam Ibn Abi Hatim (R.H) ne yahan par bohat kuch likha hai, hasil sab ka yahi hai.

Quran-e-Kareem se farar Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke is fe'l par izhar kar raha hai jo woh Quran ke na samajhne aur is mein gaur-o-fikr na karne mein kar rahe thay aur is se munh pher lete thay. Halan-ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat ne un par apni woh pak aur bartar kitab nazil farmayi thi jo kisi Nabi par nahin utari gayi, yeh sab se akmal, ashraf aur afzal kitab hai. Un ke baap dade jahiliyat mein mare thay jin ke hathon mein koi ilhami kitab na thi, un mein koi paighambar nahin aaya tha. Toh unhein chahiye tha ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maante, Kitabullah ki qadr karte aur din raat is par amal karte jaise ke un mein ke samajh daron ne kiya ke woh musalman muttabi-e-Rasool ho gaye aur apne a'maal se Allah ko raazi razamand kar diya. Afsos kuffar ne aqalmandi se kaam na liya. Quran ki mutashabeh aayaton ke peeche par kar halak ho gaye. Kya yeh log Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaante nahin? Kya aap ki sadaqat, amanat, diyanat unhein maloom nahin? Aap toh unhi mein paida huye, unhi mein pale, unhi mein bare huye, phir kya wajah hai ke aaj use jhoota kehne lage jise is se pehle sacha kehte thay? Doghle ho rahe thay. Hazrat Jafar bin Abi Talib (R.A) ne Shah-e-Habash Najashi (R.H) se sar-e-darbar yahi farmaya tha ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen wahdahu la sharik ne hum mein ek Rasool bheja hai jis ka nasab, jis ki sadaqat, jis ki amanat humein khoob maloom thi. Hazrat Mugheera bin Shu'ba (R.A) ne Kisra se ba-waqt-e-jang maidan mein yahi farmaya tha, Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb ne Shah-e-Room se yahi farmaya tha jab ke sar-e-darbar us ne un se aur un ke sathiyon se poocha tha. Halan-ke us waqt tak woh musalman bhi nahin thay lekin unhein aap ki sadaqat, amanat, diyanat, sachayi aur nasab ki umdagi ka iqrar karna para. Kehte thay ise junoon hai ya is ne Quran apni taraf se ghar liya hai halan-ke baat is tarah se nahin. Haqeeqat sirf yeh hai ke un ke dilon mein iman se khali hain, yeh Quran par nazrein nahin daalte aur jo zaban par aata hai bak dete hain. Quran toh woh kalam hai jis ki misl aur nazeer se sari duniya aajiz aa gayi, bawajood sakht mukhalifat ke aur bawajood poori koshish aur intehayi muqable ke kisi se na ban para ke is jaisa Quran khud bana leta ya sab ki madad le kar is jaisi ek hi surat bana lata. Yeh toh sarasar haq hai aur unhein haq se chir hai. Pichla jumla haal hai aur ho sakta hai ke khabriya mustanfe'a, Wallahu A'lam. Mazkoor hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba ek shakhs se farmaya musalman ho ja, us ne kaha agarche mujhe yeh nagawar ho? Aap ne farmaya haan agarche nagawar ho. Ek riwayat mein ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raste mein mila, aap ne us se farmaya Islam qabool kar, use yeh bura mehsoos hua, us ka chehra gusse se surkh ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya dekho agar tum kisi ghair-abad khatarnak ghalat raste par chale ja rahe ho aur tumhein ek shakhs mile jis ke naam nasab se, jis ki sachayi aur amanat dari se tum bakhoobi waqif ho, woh tum se kahe ke is raste par chalo jo wasee, aasaan, seedha aur saaf hai, batao tum us ke bataye huye raste par chaloge ya nahin?

Us ne kaha haan zaroor. Aap ne farmaya bas tu yaqeen mano qasam Allah ki tum us din bhi sakht dushwar aur khatarnak raah se bhi zyada buri raah par ho aur main tumhein aasaan raah ki dawat deta hoon meri maan lo. Mazkoor hai ke ek aur aise hi shakhs se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tha jab ke us ne dawat-e-Islam ka bura manaya batata? Agar tere do saathi hon ek to saccha amanat-dar dusra jhoota khayanat-pesha batao tum kis se mohabbat karoge? Us ne kaha sacche ameen se. Farmaya isi tarah tum log apne Rab ke nazdeek ho. Haq se murad baqol Suddi (R.H) khud Allah Ta'ala hai yani Allah Ta'ala agar inhi ki marzi ke mutabiq shariat muqarrar karta to zameeno aasman bigad jaate jaise aur aayat mein hai ke kafiron ne kaha in dono bastiyon mein se kisi bade shakhs ke oopar yeh Quran kyun na utra? Is ke jawab mein farman hai ke kya Allah ki rahmat ki taqseem in ke hathon mein hai? Aur aayat mein hai ke aur agar unhein mulk ke kisi hisse ka malik bana diya hota to kisi ko ek kodi bhi na deta. Pas in aayaton mein Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya ke insani dimagh makhlooq ke intezam ki qabiliyat mein na-ahl hai. Yeh Allah hi ki shaan hai ke us ki sifatein us ke farman us ke afaal us ki shariat us ki taqdeer us ki tadbeer tamam makhlooq ko haavi hai aur tamam makhlooq ki haajat bar-aari aur un ki maslahat ke mutabiq hai. Us ke siwa na koi mabood hai na palanhar hai. Phir farmaya is Quran ko in ki nasihat ke liye hum laye aur yeh is se munh mod rahe hain. Phir irshad hai ke tu tableegh-e-Quran par in se koi ujrat nahin mangta teri nazrein Allah par hain wahi tujhe is ka ajr dega jaise farmaya jo badla main tum se mangoon woh bhi tumhein hi diya, main to ajr ka talib sirf Allah hi se hoon. Ek aayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum hua ke elaan kar do ke na main koi badla chahta hoon na main takalluf karne walon mein se hoon aur jagah hai keh de ke main tum se koi ujrat nahin chahta, sirf qarabat-dari ki mohabbat ka khwahan hoon. Surah Yaseen mein hai ke shahar ke door ke kinare se jo shakhs dauda hua aaya us ne apni qoum se kaha ke ae meri qoum ke logon nabiyon ki ita'at karo jo tum se kisi ajr ke khwahan nahin yahan farmaya wahi behtareen raaziq hai. Tu logon ko sahih raah ki taraf bula raha hai. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) soye hue the ke do farishte aaye ek aap ke paon mein baitha dusra sar ki taraf. Pehle ne dusre se kaha in ki aur dusron ki ummat ki misalein bayan karo. Us ne kaha in ki misal un musafiron ke qafle ki misl hai jo ek biyaban chatyal maidan mein the un ke paas na tosha tha na dana pani na aage badhne ki quwwat na peeche hatne ki taqat hairan the ke kya hoga itne mein unhon ne dekha ke ek bhala aadmi ek shareef insaan umda libas pehne hue aa raha hai us ne aate hi un ki ghabrahat aur pareshani dekh kar un se kaha ke agar tum mera kaha mano aur mere peeche chalo to main tumhein phalon se lade hue baghon aur pani se bhare hauzon par pahuncha doon.

Sab ne us ki baat maan li aur us ne unhein fil-waqai hare bhare taro-taza baghon aur jaari chashmon mein pahuncha diya. Yahan un logon ne be-rok tok khaya piya aur aasuda-haali ki wajah se mote taza ho gaye. Ek din us ne kaha dekho main tumhein is halakat-o-iflas se bacha kar yahan laya aur is farigh-ul-baali mein pahunchaya. Ab agar tum meri mano to main tumhein is se bhi aala baghat aur is se tayyab jagah aur is se bhi zyada jagah lehredar nehron ki taraf le chalun. Is par ek jamaat to tayyar ho gayi aur unhon ne kaha hum aap ke sath hain lekin dusri jamaat ne kaha hamein aur zyada ki zaroorat nahin bas yahin reh pade. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main tumhein apni bahon mein samet kar tumhari kamrein pakar pakar kar jahannam se rok raha hun. Lekin tum parnalon aur barsati kiron ki tarah mere hathon se chhoot chhoot kar aag mein gir rahe ho. Kya tum yeh chahte ho? Ke main tumhein chhor dun? Suno main to Hauz-e-Kausar par bhi tumhara peshwa aur meer-e-saman hun. Wahan tum akka dukka aur giroh giroh ban kar mere paas aaoge. Main tumhein tumhari nishaniyon, alamaton aur namon se pehchan lunga. Jaise ke ek nau-warid anjaan aadmi apne unton ko dusron ke unton se tameez kar leta hai. Mere dekhte hue tum mein se ba'az ko bayin taraf wale azab ke farishte pakar kar le jana chahenge to main Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz karunga. Ke Aye Allah yeh meri qaum ke, meri ummat ke log hain. Pas jawab diya jayega aap ko nahin maloom ke inhon ne aap ke baad kya kya bid'atein nikali thin? Yeh aap ke baad apni eriyon ke bal laut-te hi rahe. Main unhein bhi pehchan lunga jo Qayamat ke din apni gardan par bakri liye hue aayega jo bakri cheekh rahi hogi, woh mera naam le kar aawazein de raha hoga. Lekin main us se saaf keh dunga ke main Allah ke samne tujhe kuch kaam nahin aa sakta, main ne to Allah ki baatein pahuncha di thin. Isi tarah koi hoga jo unt ko liye hue aayega jo bilbila raha hoga. Nida karega ke Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main keh dunga ke main Allah ke han tere liye kuch ikhtiyar nahin rakhta, main ne to haq baat tumhein pahuncha di thi. Ba'az aayenge jin ki gardan par ghoda sawar hoga jo hinhina raha hoga, woh bhi mujhe aawaz dega aur main yahi jawab dunga. Ba'az aayenge aur mashkein lade hue pukarenge Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main kahunga tumhare kisi mamla se mera koi talluq nahin. Main to tum tak haq baat pahuncha chuka tha. Imam Ali bin Madini (R.H) farmate hain isi hadith ki sanad hai to hasan lekin is ka ek rawi Hafs bin Hameed majhool hai lekin Imam Yahya bin Abi Mu'een ne ise saleh kaha hai aur Nasai aur Ibn-e-Hibban ne bhi ise siqah kaha hai. Aakhirat ka yaqeen na rakhne wale rah-e-rast se hate hue hain. Jab koi shakhs seedhi rah se hat gaya to Arab kehte hain nakaba fulan-un an-it-tareeq.

Un ke kufr ki pukhtagi bayan ho rahi hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un se sakhti ko hata de, unhein Quran suna aur samjha bhi de, toh bhi yeh apne kufr-o-inaad se, sarkashi aur takabbur se baaz na aayenge. Jo kuch nahin hua woh jab hoga toh kis tarah hoga is ka ilm Allah ko hai. Is liye aur jagah irshad farmaya diya hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un mein bhalai dekhta toh zaroor unhein apne ahkaam sunata, agar unhein sunata bhi toh woh munh phere hue us se ghoom jaate. Yeh toh jahannam ke saamne khade ho kar hi yaqeen karenge aur us waqt kahenge kaash ke hum lota diye jaate aur Rabb ki baaton ko na jhutlate aur yaqeen-mand ho jaate. Is se pehle jo chupa tha woh ab khul gaya. Baat yeh hai ke agar yeh lota bhi diye jayen toh phir se mana karda kaamon ki taraf lot aayenge. Pas yeh woh baat hai jo hogi nahin lekin agar ho toh kya ho? Ise Allah jaanta hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'lau' se jo jumla Quran-e-Kareem mein hai woh kabhi waqay hone wala nahin.

Quran-e-Kareem se farar Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke is fe'l par izhar kar raha hai jo woh Quran ke na samajhne aur is mein gaur-o-fikr na karne mein kar rahe thay aur is se munh pher lete thay. Halan-ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat ne un par apni woh pak aur bartar kitab nazil farmayi thi jo kisi Nabi par nahin utari gayi, yeh sab se akmal, ashraf aur afzal kitab hai. Toh unhein chahiye tha ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maante, Kitabullah ki qadr karte aur din raat is par amal karte jaise ke un mein ke samajh daron ne kiya ke woh musalman muttabi-e-Rasool ho gaye aur apne a'maal se Allah ko raazi razamand kar diya. Afsos kuffar ne aqalmandi se kaam na liya. Quran ki mutashabeh aayaton ke peeche par kar halak ho gaye. Kya yeh log Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaante nahin? Yeh toh sarasar haq hai aur unhein haq se chir hai. Pichla jumla haal hai aur ho sakta hai ke khabriya mustanfe'a, Wallahu A'lam. Mazkoor hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba ek shakhs se farmaya musalman ho ja, us ne kaha agarche mujhe yeh nagawar ho? Aap ne farmaya haan agarche nagawar ho. Ek riwayat mein ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raste mein mila, aap ne us se farmaya Islam qabool kar, use yeh bura mehsoos hua, us ka chehra gusse se surkh ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya dekho agar tum kisi ghair-abad khatarnak ghalat raste par chale ja rahe ho aur tumhein ek shakhs mile jis ke naam nasab se, jis ki sachayi aur amanat dari se tum bakhoobi waqif ho, woh tum se kahe ke is raste par chalo jo wasee, aasaan, seedha aur saaf hai, batao tum us ke bataye huye raste par chaloge ya nahin?

Pas in aayaton mein Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya ke insani dimagh makhlooq ke intezam ki qabiliyat mein na-ahl hai. Yeh Allah hi ki shaan hai ke us ki sifatein us ke farman us ke afaal us ki shariat us ki taqdeer us ki tadbeer tamam makhlooq ko haavi hai aur tamam makhlooq ki haajat bar-aari aur un ki maslahat ke mutabiq hai. Us ke siwa na koi mabood hai na palanhar hai. Phir farmaya is Quran ko in ki nasihat ke liye hum laye aur yeh is se munh mod rahe hain. Phir irshad hai ke tu tableegh-e-Quran par in se koi ujrat nahin mangta teri nazrein Allah par hain wahi tujhe is ka ajr dega jaise farmaya jo badla main tum se mangoon woh bhi tumhein hi diya, main to ajr ka talib sirf Allah hi se hoon. Ek aayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum hua ke elaan kar do ke na main koi badla chahta hoon na main takalluf karne walon mein se hoon aur jagah hai keh de ke main tum se koi ujrat nahin chahta, sirf qarabat-dari ki mohabbat ka khwahan hoon. Surah Yaseen mein hai ke shahar ke door ke kinare se jo shakhs dauda hua aaya us ne apni qoum se kaha ke ae meri qoum ke logon nabiyon ki ita'at karo jo tum se kisi ajr ke khwahan nahin yahan farmaya wahi behtareen raaziq hai. Tu logon ko sahih raah ki taraf bula raha hai. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) soye hue the ke do farishte aaye ek aap ke paon mein baitha dusra sar ki taraf. Pehle ne dusre se kaha in ki aur dusron ki ummat ki misalein bayan karo. Us ne kaha in ki misal un musafiron ke qafle ki misl hai jo ek biyaban chatyal maidan mein the un ke paas na tosha tha na dana pani na aage badhne ki quwwat na peeche hatne ki taqat hairan the ke kya hoga itne mein unhon ne dekha ke ek bhala aadmi ek shareef insaan umda libas pehne hue aa raha hai us ne aate hi un ki ghabrahat aur pareshani dekh kar un se kaha ke agar tum mera kaha mano aur mere peeche chalo to main tumhein phalon se lade hue baghon aur pani se bhare hauzon par pahuncha doon.

Sab ne us ki baat maan li aur us ne unhein fil-waqai hare bhare taro-taza baghon aur jaari chashmon mein pahuncha diya. Yahan un logon ne be-rok tok khaya piya aur aasuda-haali ki wajah se mote taza ho gaye. Ek din us ne kaha dekho main tumhein is halakat-o-iflas se bacha kar yahan laya aur is farigh-ul-baali mein pahunchaya. Ab agar tum meri mano to main tumhein is se bhi aala baghat aur is se tayyab jagah aur is se bhi zyada jagah lehredar nehron ki taraf le chalun. Is par ek jamaat to tayyar ho gayi aur unhon ne kaha hum aap ke sath hain lekin dusri jamaat ne kaha hamein aur zyada ki zaroorat nahin bas yahin reh pade. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main tumhein apni bahon mein samet kar tumhari kamrein pakar pakar kar jahannam se rok raha hun. Lekin tum parnalon aur barsati kiron ki tarah mere hathon se chhoot chhoot kar aag mein gir rahe ho. Kya tum yeh chahte ho? Ke main tumhein chhor dun? Suno main to Hauz-e-Kausar par bhi tumhara peshwa aur meer-e-saman hun. Wahan tum akka dukka aur giroh giroh ban kar mere paas aaoge. Main tumhein tumhari nishaniyon, alamaton aur namon se pehchan lunga. Jaise ke ek nau-warid anjaan aadmi apne unton ko dusron ke unton se tameez kar leta hai. Mere dekhte hue tum mein se ba'az ko bayin taraf wale azab ke farishte pakar kar le jana chahenge to main Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz karunga. Ke Aye Allah yeh meri qaum ke, meri ummat ke log hain. Pas jawab diya jayega aap ko nahin maloom ke inhon ne aap ke baad kya kya bid'atein nikali thin? Yeh aap ke baad apni eriyon ke bal laut-te hi rahe. Main unhein bhi pehchan lunga jo Qayamat ke din apni gardan par bakri liye hue aayega jo bakri cheekh rahi hogi, woh mera naam le kar aawazein de raha hoga. Lekin main us se saaf keh dunga ke main Allah ke samne tujhe kuch kaam nahin aa sakta, main ne to Allah ki baatein pahuncha di thin. Isi tarah koi hoga jo unt ko liye hue aayega jo bilbila raha hoga. Nida karega ke Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main keh dunga ke main Allah ke han tere liye kuch ikhtiyar nahin rakhta, main ne to haq baat tumhein pahuncha di thi. Ba'az aayenge jin ki gardan par ghoda sawar hoga jo hinhina raha hoga, woh bhi mujhe aawaz dega aur main yahi jawab dunga. Ba'az aayenge aur mashkein lade hue pukarenge Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main kahunga tumhare kisi mamla se mera koi talluq nahin. Main to tum tak haq baat pahuncha chuka tha. Imam Ali bin Madini (R.H) farmate hain isi hadith ki sanad hai to hasan lekin is ka ek rawi Hafs bin Hameed majhool hai lekin Imam Yahya bin Abi Mu'een ne ise saleh kaha hai aur Nasai aur Ibn-e-Hibban ne bhi ise siqah kaha hai. Aakhirat ka yaqeen na rakhne wale rah-e-rast se hate hue hain. Jab koi shakhs seedhi rah se hat gaya to Arab kehte hain nakaba fulan-un an-it-tareeq.

Un ke kufr ki pukhtagi bayan ho rahi hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un se sakhti ko hata de, unhein Quran suna aur samjha bhi de, toh bhi yeh apne kufr-o-inaad se, sarkashi aur takabbur se baaz na aayenge. Jo kuch nahin hua woh jab hoga toh kis tarah hoga is ka ilm Allah ko hai. Is liye aur jagah irshad farmaya diya hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un mein bhalai dekhta toh zaroor unhein apne ahkaam sunata, agar unhein sunata bhi toh woh munh phere hue us se ghoom jaate. Yeh toh jahannam ke saamne khade ho kar hi yaqeen karenge aur us waqt kahenge kaash ke hum lota diye jaate aur Rabb ki baaton ko na jhutlate aur yaqeen-mand ho jaate. Is se pehle jo chupa tha woh ab khul gaya. Baat yeh hai ke agar yeh lota bhi diye jayen toh phir se mana karda kaamon ki taraf lot aayenge. Pas yeh woh baat hai jo hogi nahin lekin agar ho toh kya ho? Ise Allah jaanta hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'lau' se jo jumla Quran-e-Kareem mein hai woh kabhi waqay hone wala nahin.

Quran-e-Kareem se farar Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke is fe'l par izhar kar raha hai jo woh Quran ke na samajhne aur is mein gaur-o-fikr na karne mein kar rahe thay aur is se munh pher lete thay. Halan-ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat ne un par apni woh pak aur bartar kitab nazil farmayi thi jo kisi Nabi par nahin utari gayi, yeh sab se akmal, ashraf aur afzal kitab hai. Un ke baap dade jahiliyat mein mare thay jin ke hathon mein koi ilhami kitab na thi, un mein koi paighambar nahin aaya tha. Toh unhein chahiye tha ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maante, Kitabullah ki qadr karte aur din raat is par amal karte jaise ke un mein ke samajh daron ne kiya ke woh musalman muttabi-e-Rasool ho gaye aur apne a'maal se Allah ko raazi razamand kar diya. Afsos kuffar ne aqalmandi se kaam na liya. Quran ki mutashabeh aayaton ke peeche par kar halak ho gaye. Kya yeh log Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaante nahin? Kya aap ki sadaqat, amanat, diyanat unhein maloom nahin? Aap toh unhi mein paida huye, unhi mein pale, unhi mein bare huye, phir kya wajah hai ke aaj use jhoota kehne lage jise is se pehle sacha kehte thay? Doghle ho rahe thay. Hazrat Jafar bin Abi Talib (R.A) ne Shah-e-Habash Najashi (R.H) se sar-e-darbar yahi farmaya tha ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen wahdahu la sharik ne hum mein ek Rasool bheja hai jis ka nasab, jis ki sadaqat, jis ki amanat humein khoob maloom thi. Hazrat Mugheera bin Shu'ba (R.A) ne Kisra se ba-waqt-e-jang maidan mein yahi farmaya tha, Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb ne Shah-e-Room se yahi farmaya tha jab ke sar-e-darbar us ne un se aur un ke sathiyon se poocha tha. Halan-ke us waqt tak woh musalman bhi nahin thay lekin unhein aap ki sadaqat, amanat, diyanat, sachayi aur nasab ki umdagi ka iqrar karna para. Kehte thay ise junoon hai ya is ne Quran apni taraf se ghar liya hai halan-ke baat is tarah se nahin. Haqeeqat sirf yeh hai ke un ke dilon mein iman se khali hain, yeh Quran par nazrein nahin daalte aur jo zaban par aata hai bak dete hain. Quran toh woh kalam hai jis ki misl aur nazeer se sari duniya aajiz aa gayi, bawajood sakht mukhalifat ke aur bawajood poori koshish aur intehayi muqable ke kisi se na ban para ke is jaisa Quran khud bana leta ya sab ki madad le kar is jaisi ek hi surat bana lata. Yeh toh sarasar haq hai aur unhein haq se chir hai. Pichla jumla haal hai aur ho sakta hai ke khabriya mustanfe'a, Wallahu A'lam. Mazkoor hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba ek shakhs se farmaya musalman ho ja, us ne kaha agarche mujhe yeh nagawar ho? Aap ne farmaya haan agarche nagawar ho. Ek riwayat mein ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raste mein mila, aap ne us se farmaya Islam qabool kar, use yeh bura mehsoos hua, us ka chehra gusse se surkh ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya dekho agar tum kisi ghair-abad khatarnak ghalat raste par chale ja rahe ho aur tumhein ek shakhs mile jis ke naam nasab se, jis ki sachayi aur amanat dari se tum bakhoobi waqif ho, woh tum se kahe ke is raste par chalo jo wasee, aasaan, seedha aur saaf hai, batao tum us ke bataye huye raste par chaloge ya nahin?

Aap ne farmaya bas tu yaqeen mano qasam Allah ki tum us din bhi sakht dushwar aur khatarnak raah se bhi zyada buri raah par ho aur main tumhein aasaan raah ki dawat deta hoon meri maan lo. Mazkoor hai ke ek aur aise hi shakhs se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tha jab ke us ne dawat-e-Islam ka bura manaya batata? Agar tere do saathi hon ek to saccha amanat-dar dusra jhoota khayanat-pesha batao tum kis se mohabbat karoge? Us ne kaha sacche ameen se. Farmaya isi tarah tum log apne Rab ke nazdeek ho. Haq se murad baqol Suddi (R.H) khud Allah Ta'ala hai yani Allah Ta'ala agar inhi ki marzi ke mutabiq shariat muqarrar karta to zameeno aasman bigad jaate jaise aur aayat mein hai ke kafiron ne kaha in dono bastiyon mein se kisi bade shakhs ke oopar yeh Quran kyun na utra? Is ke jawab mein farman hai ke kya Allah ki rahmat ki taqseem in ke hathon mein hai? Aur aayat mein hai ke aur agar unhein mulk ke kisi hisse ka malik bana diya hota to kisi ko ek kodi bhi na deta. Pas in aayaton mein Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya ke insani dimagh makhlooq ke intezam ki qabiliyat mein na-ahl hai. Yeh Allah hi ki shaan hai ke us ki sifatein us ke farman us ke afaal us ki shariat us ki taqdeer us ki tadbeer tamam makhlooq ko haavi hai aur tamam makhlooq ki haajat bar-aari aur un ki maslahat ke mutabiq hai. Us ke siwa na koi mabood hai na palanhar hai. Phir farmaya is Quran ko in ki nasihat ke liye hum laye aur yeh is se munh mod rahe hain. Phir irshad hai ke tu tableegh-e-Quran par in se koi ujrat nahin mangta teri nazrein Allah par hain wahi tujhe is ka ajr dega jaise farmaya jo badla main tum se mangoon woh bhi tumhein hi diya, main to ajr ka talib sirf Allah hi se hoon. Ek aayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum hua ke elaan kar do ke na main koi badla chahta hoon na main takalluf karne walon mein se hoon aur jagah hai keh de ke main tum se koi ujrat nahin chahta, sirf qarabat-dari ki mohabbat ka khwahan hoon. Surah Yaseen mein hai ke shahar ke door ke kinare se jo shakhs dauda hua aaya us ne apni qoum se kaha ke ae meri qoum ke logon nabiyon ki ita'at karo jo tum se kisi ajr ke khwahan nahin yahan farmaya wahi behtareen raaziq hai. Tu logon ko sahih raah ki taraf bula raha hai. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) soye hue the ke do farishte aaye ek aap ke paon mein baitha dusra sar ki taraf. Pehle ne dusre se kaha in ki aur dusron ki ummat ki misalein bayan karo. Us ne kaha in ki misal un musafiron ke qafle ki misl hai jo ek biyaban chatyal maidan mein the un ke paas na tosha tha na dana pani na aage badhne ki quwwat na peeche hatne ki taqat hairan the ke kya hoga itne mein unhon ne dekha ke ek bhala aadmi ek shareef insaan umda libas pehne hue aa raha hai us ne aate hi un ki ghabrahat aur pareshani dekh kar un se kaha ke agar tum mera kaha mano aur mere peeche chalo to main tumhein phalon se lade hue baghon aur pani se bhare hauzon par pahuncha doon.

Sab ne us ki baat maan li aur us ne unhein fil-waqai hare bhare taro-taza baghon aur jaari chashmon mein pahuncha diya. Yahan un logon ne be-rok tok khaya piya aur aasuda-haali ki wajah se mote taza ho gaye. Ek din us ne kaha dekho main tumhein is halakat-o-iflas se bacha kar yahan laya aur is farigh-ul-baali mein pahunchaya. Ab agar tum meri mano to main tumhein is se bhi aala baghat aur is se tayyab jagah aur is se bhi zyada jagah lehredar nehron ki taraf le chalun. Is par ek jamaat to tayyar ho gayi aur unhon ne kaha hum aap ke sath hain lekin dusri jamaat ne kaha hamein aur zyada ki zaroorat nahin bas yahin reh pade. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main tumhein apni bahon mein samet kar tumhari kamrein pakar pakar kar jahannam se rok raha hun. Lekin tum parnalon aur barsati kiron ki tarah mere hathon se chhoot chhoot kar aag mein gir rahe ho. Kya tum yeh chahte ho? Ke main tumhein chhor dun? Suno main to Hauz-e-Kausar par bhi tumhara peshwa aur meer-e-saman hun. Wahan tum akka dukka aur giroh giroh ban kar mere paas aaoge. Main tumhein tumhari nishaniyon, alamaton aur namon se pehchan lunga. Jaise ke ek nau-warid anjaan aadmi apne unton ko dusron ke unton se tameez kar leta hai. Mere dekhte hue tum mein se ba'az ko bayin taraf wale azab ke farishte pakar kar le jana chahenge to main Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz karunga. Ke Aye Allah yeh meri qaum ke, meri ummat ke log hain. Pas jawab diya jayega aap ko nahin maloom ke inhon ne aap ke baad kya kya bid'atein nikali thin? Yeh aap ke baad apni eriyon ke bal laut-te hi rahe. Main unhein bhi pehchan lunga jo Qayamat ke din apni gardan par bakri liye hue aayega jo bakri cheekh rahi hogi, woh mera naam le kar aawazein de raha hoga. Lekin main us se saaf keh dunga ke main Allah ke samne tujhe kuch kaam nahin aa sakta, main ne to Allah ki baatein pahuncha di thin. Isi tarah koi hoga jo unt ko liye hue aayega jo bilbila raha hoga. Nida karega ke Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main keh dunga ke main Allah ke han tere liye kuch ikhtiyar nahin rakhta, main ne to haq baat tumhein pahuncha di thi. Ba'az aayenge jin ki gardan par ghoda sawar hoga jo hinhina raha hoga, woh bhi mujhe aawaz dega aur main yahi jawab dunga. Ba'az aayenge aur mashkein lade hue pukarenge Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main kahunga tumhare kisi mamla se mera koi talluq nahin. Main to tum tak haq baat pahuncha chuka tha. Imam Ali bin Madini (R.H) farmate hain isi hadith ki sanad hai to hasan lekin is ka ek rawi Hafs bin Hameed majhool hai lekin Imam Yahya bin Abi Mu'een ne ise saleh kaha hai aur Nasai aur Ibn-e-Hibban ne bhi ise siqah kaha hai. Aakhirat ka yaqeen na rakhne wale rah-e-rast se hate hue hain. Jab koi shakhs seedhi rah se hat gaya to Arab kehte hain nakaba fulan-un an-it-tareeq.

Un ke kufr ki pukhtagi bayan ho rahi hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un se sakhti ko hata de, unhein Quran suna aur samjha bhi de, toh bhi yeh apne kufr-o-inaad se, sarkashi aur takabbur se baaz na aayenge. Jo kuch nahin hua woh jab hoga toh kis tarah hoga is ka ilm Allah ko hai. Is liye aur jagah irshad farmaya diya hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un mein bhalai dekhta toh zaroor unhein apne ahkaam sunata, agar unhein sunata bhi toh woh munh phere hue us se ghoom jaate. Yeh toh jahannam ke saamne khade ho kar hi yaqeen karenge aur us waqt kahenge kaash ke hum lota diye jaate aur Rabb ki baaton ko na jhutlate aur yaqeen-mand ho jaate. Is se pehle jo chupa tha woh ab khul gaya. Baat yeh hai ke agar yeh lota bhi diye jayen toh phir se mana karda kaamon ki taraf lot aayenge. Pas yeh woh baat hai jo hogi nahin lekin agar ho toh kya ho? Ise Allah jaanta hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'lau' se jo jumla Quran-e-Kareem mein hai woh kabhi waqay hone wala nahin.

Quran-e-Kareem se farar Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke is fe'l par izhar kar raha hai jo woh Quran ke na samajhne aur is mein gaur-o-fikr na karne mein kar rahe thay aur is se munh pher lete thay. Aap toh unhi mein paida huye, unhi mein pale, unhi mein bare huye, phir kya wajah hai ke aaj use jhoota kehne lage jise is se pehle sacha kehte thay? Doghle ho rahe thay. Yeh toh sarasar haq hai aur unhein haq se chir hai. Pichla jumla haal hai aur ho sakta hai ke khabriya mustanfe'a, Wallahu A'lam. Mazkoor hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba ek shakhs se farmaya musalman ho ja, us ne kaha agarche mujhe yeh nagawar ho? Aap ne farmaya haan agarche nagawar ho. Ek riwayat mein ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raste mein mila, aap ne us se farmaya Islam qabool kar, use yeh bura mehsoos hua, us ka chehra gusse se surkh ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya dekho agar tum kisi ghair-abad khatarnak ghalat raste par chale ja rahe ho aur tumhein ek shakhs mile jis ke naam nasab se, jis ki sachayi aur amanat dari se tum bakhoobi waqif ho, woh tum se kahe ke is raste par chalo jo wasee, aasaan, seedha aur saaf hai, batao tum us ke bataye huye raste par chaloge ya nahin?

Agar tere do saathi hon ek to saccha amanat-dar dusra jhoota khayanat-pesha batao tum kis se mohabbat karoge? Us ne kaha sacche ameen se. Farmaya isi tarah tum log apne Rab ke nazdeek ho. Haq se murad baqol Suddi (R.H) khud Allah Ta'ala hai yani Allah Ta'ala agar inhi ki marzi ke mutabiq shariat muqarrar karta to zameeno aasman bigad jaate jaise aur aayat mein hai ke kafiron ne kaha in dono bastiyon mein se kisi bade shakhs ke oopar yeh Quran kyun na utra? Is ke jawab mein farman hai ke kya Allah ki rahmat ki taqseem in ke hathon mein hai? Aur aayat mein hai ke aur agar unhein mulk ke kisi hisse ka malik bana diya hota to kisi ko ek kodi bhi na deta. Pas in aayaton mein Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya ke insani dimagh makhlooq ke intezam ki qabiliyat mein na-ahl hai. Yeh Allah hi ki shaan hai ke us ki sifatein us ke farman us ke afaal us ki shariat us ki taqdeer us ki tadbeer tamam makhlooq ko haavi hai aur tamam makhlooq ki haajat bar-aari aur un ki maslahat ke mutabiq hai. Us ke siwa na koi mabood hai na palanhar hai. Phir farmaya is Quran ko in ki nasihat ke liye hum laye aur yeh is se munh mod rahe hain. Phir irshad hai ke tu tableegh-e-Quran par in se koi ujrat nahin mangta teri nazrein Allah par hain wahi tujhe is ka ajr dega jaise farmaya jo badla main tum se mangoon woh bhi tumhein hi diya, main to ajr ka talib sirf Allah hi se hoon. Ek aayat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum hua ke elaan kar do ke na main koi badla chahta hoon na main takalluf karne walon mein se hoon aur jagah hai keh de ke main tum se koi ujrat nahin chahta, sirf qarabat-dari ki mohabbat ka khwahan hoon. Surah Yaseen mein hai ke shahar ke door ke kinare se jo shakhs dauda hua aaya us ne apni qoum se kaha ke ae meri qoum ke logon nabiyon ki ita'at karo jo tum se kisi ajr ke khwahan nahin yahan farmaya wahi behtareen raaziq hai. Tu logon ko sahih raah ki taraf bula raha hai. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) soye hue the ke do farishte aaye ek aap ke paon mein baitha dusra sar ki taraf. Pehle ne dusre se kaha in ki aur dusron ki ummat ki misalein bayan karo. Us ne kaha in ki misal un musafiron ke qafle ki misl hai jo ek biyaban chatyal maidan mein the un ke paas na tosha tha na dana pani na aage badhne ki quwwat na peeche hatne ki taqat hairan the ke kya hoga itne mein unhon ne dekha ke ek bhala aadmi ek shareef insaan umda libas pehne hue aa raha hai us ne aate hi un ki ghabrahat aur pareshani dekh kar un se kaha ke agar tum mera kaha mano aur mere peeche chalo to main tumhein phalon se lade hue baghon aur pani se bhare hauzon par pahuncha doon.

Sab ne us ki baat maan li aur us ne unhein fil-waqai hare bhare taro-taza baghon aur jaari chashmon mein pahuncha diya. Yahan un logon ne be-rok tok khaya piya aur aasuda-haali ki wajah se mote taza ho gaye. Ek din us ne kaha dekho main tumhein is halakat-o-iflas se bacha kar yahan laya aur is farigh-ul-baali mein pahunchaya. Ab agar tum meri mano to main tumhein is se bhi aala baghat aur is se tayyab jagah aur is se bhi zyada jagah lehredar nehron ki taraf le chalun. Is par ek jamaat to tayyar ho gayi aur unhon ne kaha hum aap ke sath hain lekin dusri jamaat ne kaha hamein aur zyada ki zaroorat nahin bas yahin reh pade. Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain main tumhein apni bahon mein samet kar tumhari kamrein pakar pakar kar jahannam se rok raha hun. Lekin tum parnalon aur barsati kiron ki tarah mere hathon se chhoot chhoot kar aag mein gir rahe ho. Kya tum yeh chahte ho? Ke main tumhein chhor dun? Suno main to Hauz-e-Kausar par bhi tumhara peshwa aur meer-e-saman hun. Wahan tum akka dukka aur giroh giroh ban kar mere paas aaoge. Main tumhein tumhari nishaniyon, alamaton aur namon se pehchan lunga. Jaise ke ek nau-warid anjaan aadmi apne unton ko dusron ke unton se tameez kar leta hai. Mere dekhte hue tum mein se ba'az ko bayin taraf wale azab ke farishte pakar kar le jana chahenge to main Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz karunga. Ke Aye Allah yeh meri qaum ke, meri ummat ke log hain. Pas jawab diya jayega aap ko nahin maloom ke inhon ne aap ke baad kya kya bid'atein nikali thin? Yeh aap ke baad apni eriyon ke bal laut-te hi rahe. Main unhein bhi pehchan lunga jo Qayamat ke din apni gardan par bakri liye hue aayega jo bakri cheekh rahi hogi, woh mera naam le kar aawazein de raha hoga. Lekin main us se saaf keh dunga ke main Allah ke samne tujhe kuch kaam nahin aa sakta, main ne to Allah ki baatein pahuncha di thin. Isi tarah koi hoga jo unt ko liye hue aayega jo bilbila raha hoga. Nida karega ke Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aye Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main keh dunga ke main Allah ke han tere liye kuch ikhtiyar nahin rakhta, main ne to haq baat tumhein pahuncha di thi. Ba'az aayenge jin ki gardan par ghoda sawar hoga jo hinhina raha hoga, woh bhi mujhe aawaz dega aur main yahi jawab dunga. Ba'az aayenge aur mashkein lade hue pukarenge Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main kahunga tumhare kisi mamla se mera koi talluq nahin. Main to tum tak haq baat pahuncha chuka tha. Imam Ali bin Madini (R.H) farmate hain isi hadith ki sanad hai to hasan lekin is ka ek rawi Hafs bin Hameed majhool hai lekin Imam Yahya bin Abi Mu'een ne ise saleh kaha hai aur Nasai aur Ibn-e-Hibban ne bhi ise siqah kaha hai. Aakhirat ka yaqeen na rakhne wale rah-e-rast se hate hue hain. Jab koi shakhs seedhi rah se hat gaya to Arab kehte hain nakaba fulan-un an-it-tareeq.

Un ke kufr ki pukhtagi bayan ho rahi hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un se sakhti ko hata de, unhein Quran suna aur samjha bhi de, toh bhi yeh apne kufr-o-inaad se, sarkashi aur takabbur se baaz na aayenge. Jo kuch nahin hua woh jab hoga toh kis tarah hoga is ka ilm Allah ko hai. Is liye aur jagah irshad farmaya diya hai ke agar Allah Ta'ala un mein bhalai dekhta toh zaroor unhein apne ahkaam sunata, agar unhein sunata bhi toh woh munh phere hue us se ghoom jaate. Yeh toh jahannam ke saamne khade ho kar hi yaqeen karenge aur us waqt kahenge kaash ke hum lota diye jaate aur Rabb ki baaton ko na jhutlate aur yaqeen-mand ho jaate. Is se pehle jo chupa tha woh ab khul gaya. Baat yeh hai ke agar yeh lota bhi diye jayen toh phir se mana karda kaamon ki taraf lot aayenge. Pas yeh woh baat hai jo hogi nahin lekin agar ho toh kya ho? Ise Allah jaanta hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke 'lau' se jo jumla Quran-e-Kareem mein hai woh kabhi waqay hone wala nahin.

Quran-e-Kareem se farar Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke is fe'l par izhar kar raha hai jo woh Quran ke na samajhne aur is mein gaur-o-fikr na karne mein kar rahe thay aur is se munh pher lete thay. Halan-ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat ne un par apni woh pak aur bartar kitab nazil farmayi thi jo kisi Nabi par nahin utari gayi, yeh sab se akmal, ashraf aur afzal kitab hai. Un ke baap dade jahiliyat mein mare thay jin ke hathon mein koi ilhami kitab na thi, un mein koi paighambar nahin aaya tha. Toh unhein chahiye tha ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maante, Kitabullah ki qadr karte aur din raat is par amal karte jaise ke un mein ke samajh daron ne kiya ke woh musalman muttabi-e-Rasool ho gaye aur apne a'maal se Allah ko raazi razamand kar diya. Afsos kuffar ne aqalmandi se kaam na liya. Quran ki mutashabeh aayaton ke peeche par kar halak ho gaye. Kya yeh log Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaante nahin? Kya aap ki sadaqat, amanat, diyanat unhein maloom nahin? Aap toh unhi mein paida huye, unhi mein pale, unhi mein bare huye, phir kya wajah hai ke aaj use jhoota kehne lage jise is se pehle sacha kehte thay? Doghle ho rahe thay. Hazrat Jafar bin Abi Talib (R.A) ne Shah-e-Habash Najashi (R.H) se sar-e-darbar yahi farmaya tha ke Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Aalameen wahdahu la sharik ne hum mein ek Rasool bheja hai jis ka nasab, jis ki sadaqat, jis ki amanat humein khoob maloom thi. Hazrat Mugheera bin Shu'ba (R.A) ne Kisra se ba-waqt-e-jang maidan mein yahi farmaya tha, Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb ne Shah-e-Room se yahi farmaya tha jab ke sar-e-darbar us ne un se aur un ke sathiyon se poocha tha. Halan-ke us waqt tak woh musalman bhi nahin thay lekin unhein aap ki sadaqat, amanat, diyanat, sachayi aur nasab ki umdagi ka iqrar karna para. Kehte thay ise junoon hai ya is ne Quran apni taraf se ghar liya hai halan-ke baat is tarah se nahin. Haqeeqat sirf yeh hai ke un ke dilon mein iman se khali hain, yeh Quran par nazrein nahin daalte aur jo zaban par aata hai bak dete hain. Quran toh woh kalam hai jis ki misl aur nazeer se sari duniya aajiz aa gayi, bawajood sakht mukhalifat ke aur bawajood poori koshish aur intehayi muqable ke kisi se na ban para ke is jaisa Quran khud bana leta ya sab ki madad le kar is jaisi ek hi surat bana lata. Yeh toh sarasar haq hai aur unhein haq se chir hai. Pichla jumla haal hai aur ho sakta hai ke khabriya mustanfe'a, Wallahu A'lam. Mazkoor hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba ek shakhs se farmaya musalman ho ja, us ne kaha agarche mujhe yeh nagawar ho? Aap ne farmaya haan agarche nagawar ho. Ek riwayat mein ek shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko raste mein mila, aap ne us se farmaya Islam qabool kar, use yeh bura mehsoos hua, us ka chehra gusse se surkh ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya dekho agar tum kisi ghair-abad khatarnak ghalat raste par chale ja rahe ho aur tumhein ek shakhs mile jis ke naam nasab se, jis ki sachayi aur amanat dari se tum bakhoobi waqif ho, woh tum se kahe ke is raste par chalo jo wasee, aasaan, seedha aur saaf hai, batao tum us ke bataye huye raste par chaloge ya nahin?

Jara'im ki saza paane ke bawajood nek na ban sake. Farmata hai ke hum ne unhein un ki buraiyon ki wajah se sakhtiyon aur museebaton mein bhi mubtala kiya lekin taham na to unhon ne apna kufr chhora na Allah ki taraf jhuke balkay kufr-o-zalalat par arey rahe. Na un ke dil narm hue na yeh sachay dil se hamari taraf mutawajja hue na dua ke liye haath uthaye. Jaise farman hai aayat (Falau la iz ja'ahum ba'suna tadarra'u wa lakin qasat qulubuhum wa zayyana lahumush shaitanu ma kanu ya'malun) (Surah Al-An'am: 43). Hamara azab dekh kar yeh hamari taraf aajizi se kyun na jhuke? Baat yeh hai ke un ke dil sakht ho gaye hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is aayat mein us qahat-sali ka zikr hai jo Quraishiyon par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke na maanne ke silay mein aayi thi, jis ki shikayat le kar Abu Sufyan Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye thay aur aap ko Allah ki qasmein de kar, rishtedariyon ke wastay de kar kaha tha ke hum to ab leed aur khoon khanay lage hain. (Nasa'i). Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Quraish ki shararton se tang aa kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bad-dua ki thi ke jaise Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke zamanay mein saat saal ki qahat-sali aayi thi, aisay hi qahat se ae Allah tu in par meri madad farma. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) ko qaid kar diya gaya. Wahan ek nau-umar shakhs ne kaha main aap ko jee behlanay ke liye ashaar sunaun? To aap ne farmaya "Is waqt hum azab-e-Allah mein hain aur Quran ne un ki shikayat ki hai jo aisay waqt bhi Allah ki taraf na jhukein" phir aap ne teen rozay barabar rakhay. Un se sawal kiya gaya ke yeh beech mein iftar kiye baghair rozay kaisay? To jawab diya ke ek nayi cheez idhar se hui yani qaid, to ek nayi cheez hum ne ki yani ziyadati-e-ibadat. Yahan tak ke hukm-e-Ilahi aapohncha, achanak waqt aa gaya aur jis azab ka wahm-o-guman bhi na tha woh aapara to tamam khair se mayus ho gaye, aas toot gayi aur hairat-zada reh gaye. Allah ki na'maton ko dekho, us ne kaan diye, aankhein dein, dil diya, aql-o-fahm ata farmayi ke gaur-o-fikr kar sako, Allah ki wahdaniyat ko us ke ikhtiyar ko samajh sako. Lekin jaise jaise na'matein barhin shukr kam hue, jaise farman hai to go haris kar lekin in mein se aksar be-imaan hain. Phir apni azeem-ush-shan saltanat aur qudrat ka bayan farma raha hai ke us ne makhlooq ko paida kar ke wasee zameen par phaila diya hai, phir Qayamat ke din bikhray huon ko sameit kar apne paas jama karega. Ab bhi usi ne paida kiya hai phir bhi wahi jalaye ga, koi chhota bada aagay peechay ka baqi na bache ga. Wahi boseeda aur khokhli haddiyon ka zinda karne wala aur logon ko maar dalne wala hai. Usi ke hukm se din charhta hai raat aati hai, ek hi nizam ke mutabiq ek ke baad ek aata jata hai, na suraj chand se aagay niklay na raat din par sabqat karay. Kya tum mein itni bhi aql nahin? Ke itnay baray nishanat dekh kar apne Allah ko pehchan lo?

Yahan tak ke hukm-e-Ilahi aapohncha, achanak waqt aa gaya aur jis azab ka wahm-o-guman bhi na tha woh aapara to tamam khair se mayus ho gaye, aas toot gayi aur hairat-zada reh gaye. Allah ki na'maton ko dekho, us ne kaan diye, aankhein dein, dil diya, aql-o-fahm ata farmayi ke gaur-o-fikr kar sako, Allah ki wahdaniyat ko us ke ikhtiyar ko samajh sako. Lekin jaise jaise na'matein barhin shukr kam hue, jaise farman hai to go haris kar lekin in mein se aksar be-imaan hain. Phir apni azeem-ush-shan saltanat aur qudrat ka bayan farma raha hai ke us ne makhlooq ko paida kar ke wasee zameen par phaila diya hai, phir Qayamat ke din bikhray huon ko sameit kar apne paas jama karega. Ab bhi usi ne paida kiya hai phir bhi wahi jalaye ga, koi chhota bada aagay peechay ka baqi na bache ga. Wahi boseeda aur khokhli haddiyon ka zinda karne wala aur logon ko maar dalne wala hai. Usi ke hukm se din charhta hai raat aati hai, ek hi nizam ke mutabiq ek ke baad ek aata jata hai, na suraj chand se aagay niklay na raat din par sabqat karay. Kya tum mein itni bhi aql nahin? Ke itnay baray nishanat dekh kar apne Allah ko pehchan lo?

Aur us ke ghalbe aur us ke ilm ke qail ban jao. Baat yeh hai ke is zamane ke kafir hon ya guzashta zamano ke, in sab ke dilon ki halat yaksan hai, zabanen bhi ek hi hain. Wohi bakwas jo guzashta logon ki thi, wohi in ki hai ke mar kar mitti ho jane aur sirf boseeda haddiyon ki surat mein baqi reh jane ke baad bhi dobara paida kiye jayen, yeh samajh se bahar hai. Hum se bhi yahi kaha gaya, hamare baap dadon ko bhi is se dhamkaya gaya, lekin hum ne to kisi ko mar kar zinda hote nahin dekha, hamare khayal mein to yeh sirf bakwas hai.

Ae Nabi (ﷺ)! Tum inhein jawab do ke inhein naye sire se woh Allah paida karega jis ne inhein awwal baar paida kiya hai aur jo har cheez ki paidaish ka aalim hai.

Jara'im ki saza paane ke bawajood nek na ban sake. Farmata hai ke hum ne unhein un ki buraiyon ki wajah se sakhtiyon aur museebaton mein bhi mubtala kiya lekin taham na to unhon ne apna kufr chhora na Allah ki taraf jhuke balkay kufr-o-zalalat par arey rahe. Na un ke dil narm hue na yeh sachay dil se hamari taraf mutawajja hue na dua ke liye haath uthaye. (Nasa'i). Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Quraish ki shararton se tang aa kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bad-dua ki thi ke jaise Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke zamanay mein saat saal ki qahat-sali aayi thi, aisay hi qahat se ae Allah tu in par meri madad farma. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) ko qaid kar diya gaya. Wahan ek nau-umar shakhs ne kaha main aap ko jee behlanay ke liye ashaar sunaun? Allah Ta'ala hi Ma'bud-e-Wahid hai. Allah Ta'ala Jalla Wa'ala apni wahdaniyat, khaliqiyat, tasarruf aur malkiyat ka suboot deta hai taake maloom ho jaye ke Ma'bud-e-Barhaq sirf wahi hai, us ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat nahin karni chahiye. Woh Wahid aur La-Shareek hai. Pas apne Mohtaram Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum deta hai ke aap in mushrikeen se daryaft farmayein to woh saat lafzon mein Allah ke Rabb hone ka iqrar karenge aur is mein kisi ko shareek nahin batayenge. Aap inhi ke jawab ko le kar unhein qail karein ke jab Khaliq, Malik, sirf Allah hai, us ke siwa koi nahin, phir Ma'bud bhi tanha wahi kyun na ho? Us ke sath dusron ki ibadat kyun ki jaye? Waqia yahi hai ke woh apne ma'budon ko bhi Makhlooq-e-Ilahi aur Mamluk-e-Rabb jante the lekin unhein Muqarraban-e-Rabb samajh kar is niyat se un ki ibadat karte the ke woh hamein bhi Muqarrab-e-Bargah-e-Allah bana denge. Pas hukum hota hai ke zameen aur zameen ki tamam cheezon ka Khaliq kaun hai? Is ki babat in mushrikon se sawal karo. Un ka jawab yahi hoga ke Allah Wahdahu La-Shareeka Lah. Ab tum phir un se kaho ke kya ab bhi is iqrar ke baad bhi tum itna nahin samajhte ke ibadat ke laiq bhi wahi hai kyunke Khaliq-o-Raziq wahi hai. Phir pucho ke is buland-o-bala aasman ka, is ki makhlooq ka Khaliq kaun hai? Jo Arsh jaisi zabardast cheez ka Rabb hai? Jo makhlooq ki chhat, jaise ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai ke Allah ki shaan bahut badi hai, us ka Arsh aasmanon par is tarah hai aur aap ne apne hath se qubba ki tarah bana kar bataya (Abu Dawood). Ek aur hadith mein hai ke saaton aasman aur zameen aur un ki kul makhlooq Kursi ke muqable par aisi hai jaise kisi chatyal maidan mein koi halqa pada ho aur Kursi apni tamam cheezon samet Arsh ke muqable mein bhi aisi hi hai. Ba'az Salaf se manqool hai Arsh ki ek janib se dusri janib ki doori pachaas hazaar saal ki musafat ki hai. Aur saatwein zameen se us ki bulandi pachaas hazaar saal ki musafat ki hai. Arsh ka naam Arsh us ki bulandi ki wajah se hi hai. Ka'ab Ahbar se marwi hai ke aasman Arsh ke muqable mein aise hain jaise koi qandeel aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan ho. Mujahid (R.H) ka qaul hai ke aasman-o-zameen bamuqabla-e-Arsh-e-Ilahi aise hain jaise koi chhalla kisi chatyal wasee maidan mein pada ho. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Arsh ki qudrat-o-azmat ka koi bhi siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke andaza nahin kar sakta. Ba'az Salaf ka qaul hai ke Arsh surkh rang yaqoot ka hai. Is aayat mein Arsh-e-Azeem kaha gaya hai aur is surat ke aakhir mein Arsh-e-Kareem kaha gaya hai, yani bahut bada aur bahut husn-o-khoobi wala. Pas lambai, chaudai, wus'at-o-azmat, husn-o-khoobi mein woh bahut hi a'ala-o-bala hai, isi liye logon ne ise yaqoot-e-surkh kaha hai. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ka farman hai ke tumhare Rabb ke paas raat din kuch nahin, us ke Arsh ka noor us ke chehre ke noor se hai. Al-gharaz is sawal ka jawab bhi woh yahi denge ke aasman aur Arsh ka Rabb Allah hai, to tum kaho ke phir tum us ke azab se kyun nahin darte? Us ke sath dusron ki ibadat kyun kar rahe ho.

Kitab-ut-Tafakkur wal-I'tibar mein Imam Abu Bakr Ibn-e-Abi-d-Dunya ek hadith laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) umooman is hadith ko bayan farmaya karte the ke "Jahiliyat ke zamane mein ek aurat pahar ki choti par apni bakriyan charaya karti thi, uske sath uska larka bhi tha. Ek martaba usne apni maa se daryaft kiya ke amma jaan tumhein kisne paida kiya hai? Usne kaha Allah ne. Kaha mere walid ko kisne paida kiya? Usne jawab diya Allah ne. Poocha aur in paharon ko amma kisne banaya hai? Maa ne jawab diya inka Khaliq bhi Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Poocha aur in hamari bakriyon ka khaliq kaun hai? Maa ne kaha Allah hi hai. Usne kaha SubhanAllah, Allah ki itni bari shaan hai! Bas is qadar azmat uske dil mein Allah Ta'ala ki sama gayi ke woh thar-thar kanpne laga aur pahar se gir para aur jaan Allah ke supurd kar di." Iska ek rawi zara theek nahin, wallahu a'lam. Daryaft karo ke tamam mulk ka malik har cheez ka mukhtar kaun hai? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qasam umooman in lafzon mein hoti thi ke uski qasam jiske hath mein meri jaan hai aur jab koi takeedi qasam khate to farmate uski qasam jo dilon ka malik aur unke pherne wala hai. Phir yeh bhi pooch ke woh kaun hai? Jo sab ko panah de aur uski di hui panah ko koi tor na sake aur uske muqable par koi panah de na sake, kisi ki panah ka woh paband nahin. Ya'ni itna bara sayyid-o-malik ke tamam khalq, mulk, hukumat, usi ke hath mein hai, batao woh kaun hai? Arab mein dastoor tha ke sardar-e-qabila agar kisi ko panah de de to sara qabila uska paband hai, lekin qabile mein se koi kisi ko panah mein le le to sardar par uski pabandi nahin. Pas yahan Allah Ta'ala ki saltanat-o-azmat bayan ho rahi hai ke woh Qadir-e-Mutlaq, Hakim-e-Kul hai, uska irada koi badal nahin sakta. Woh sab se baz-purs kar le lekin kisi ki majal nahin ke us se koi sawal kar sake. Uski azmat, uski kibriyai, uska ghalba, uska dabao, uski qudrat, uski izzat, uski hikmat, uska adl be-payan aur be-misl hai. Sab makhlooq uske samne aajiz, past aur lachar hai. Ab sari makhlooq ki baz-purs karne wala hai, is sawal ka jawab bhi unke paas uske siwa koi aur nahin ke woh iqrar karein ke itna bara badshah aisa khud-mukhtar Allah Wahid hi hai. Keh de ke phir tum par kya tapki pari hai? Aisa kaunsa jadoo tum par ho gaya hai? Bawajood is iqrar ke phir bhi dusron ki parastish karte ho? Hum to unke samne haq wazeh kar chuke, Tauheed-e-Rububiyat ke sath sath Tauheed-e-Uluhiyat bayan kar di, sahih daleelein aur saaf baatein pahuncha dein aur unka ghalat go hona zahir kar diya ke yeh shareek banane mein jhoote hain aur unka jhoot khud unke iqrar se zahir-o-bahir hai, jaise ke surat ke aakhir mein farmaya ke Allah ke siwa dusron ke pukarne ki koi sanad nahin. Sirf baap dada ki taqleed par zid hai aur woh yehi kehte bhi the ke humne apne buzurgon ko isi par paya aur hum unki taqleed nahin chorenge.

Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ka farman hai ke tumhare Rabb ke paas raat din kuch nahin, us ke Arsh ka noor us ke chehre ke noor se hai. Ek martaba usne apni maa se daryaft kiya ke amma jaan tumhein kisne paida kiya hai? Usne kaha Allah ne. Kaha mere walid ko kisne paida kiya? Usne jawab diya Allah ne. Poocha aur in paharon ko amma kisne banaya hai? Maa ne jawab diya inka Khaliq bhi Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Poocha aur in hamari bakriyon ka khaliq kaun hai? Maa ne kaha Allah hi hai. Iska ek rawi zara theek nahin, wallahu a'lam. Daryaft karo ke tamam mulk ka malik har cheez ka mukhtar kaun hai? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qasam umooman in lafzon mein hoti thi ke uski qasam jiske hath mein meri jaan hai aur jab koi takeedi qasam khate to farmate uski qasam jo dilon ka malik aur unke pherne wala hai. Phir yeh bhi pooch ke woh kaun hai? Jo sab ko panah de aur uski di hui panah ko koi tor na sake aur uske muqable par koi panah de na sake, kisi ki panah ka woh paband nahin. Ya'ni itna bara sayyid-o-malik ke tamam khalq, mulk, hukumat, usi ke hath mein hai, batao woh kaun hai? Arab mein dastoor tha ke sardar-e-qabila agar kisi ko panah de de to sara qabila uska paband hai, lekin qabile mein se koi kisi ko panah mein le le to sardar par uski pabandi nahin. Pas yahan Allah Ta'ala ki saltanat-o-azmat bayan ho rahi hai ke woh Qadir-e-Mutlaq, Hakim-e-Kul hai, uska irada koi badal nahin sakta. Woh sab se baz-purs kar le lekin kisi ki majal nahin ke us se koi sawal kar sake. Uski azmat, uski kibriyai, uska ghalba, uska dabao, uski qudrat, uski izzat, uski hikmat, uska adl be-payan aur be-misl hai. Sab makhlooq uske samne aajiz, past aur lachar hai. Ab sari makhlooq ki baz-purs karne wala hai, is sawal ka jawab bhi unke paas uske siwa koi aur nahin ke woh iqrar karein ke itna bara badshah aisa khud-mukhtar Allah Wahid hi hai. Sirf baap dada ki taqleed par zid hai aur woh yehi kehte bhi the ke humne apne buzurgon ko isi par paya aur hum unki taqleed nahin chorenge.

Allah Ta'ala Jalla Wa'ala apni wahdaniyat, khaliqiyat, tasarruf aur malkiyat ka suboot deta hai taake maloom ho jaye ke Ma'bud-e-Barhaq sirf wahi hai, us ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat nahin karni chahiye. Woh Wahid aur La-Shareek hai. Pas apne Mohtaram Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum deta hai ke aap in mushrikeen se daryaft farmayein to woh saat lafzon mein Allah ke Rabb hone ka iqrar karenge aur is mein kisi ko shareek nahin batayenge. Aap inhi ke jawab ko le kar unhein qail karein ke jab Khaliq, Malik, sirf Allah hai, us ke siwa koi nahin, phir Ma'bud bhi tanha wahi kyun na ho? Us ke sath dusron ki ibadat kyun ki jaye? Waqia yahi hai ke woh apne ma'budon ko bhi Makhlooq-e-Ilahi aur Mamluk-e-Rabb jante the lekin unhein Muqarraban-e-Rabb samajh kar is niyat se un ki ibadat karte the ke woh hamein bhi Muqarrab-e-Bargah-e-Allah bana denge. Phir pucho ke is buland-o-bala aasman ka, is ki makhlooq ka Khaliq kaun hai? Jo Arsh jaisi zabardast cheez ka Rabb hai? Ek aur hadith mein hai ke saaton aasman aur zameen aur un ki kul makhlooq Kursi ke muqable par aisi hai jaise kisi chatyal maidan mein koi halqa pada ho aur Kursi apni tamam cheezon samet Arsh ke muqable mein bhi aisi hi hai. Ba'az Salaf se manqool hai Arsh ki ek janib se dusri janib ki doori pachaas hazaar saal ki musafat ki hai. Aur saatwein zameen se us ki bulandi pachaas hazaar saal ki musafat ki hai. Arsh ka naam Arsh us ki bulandi ki wajah se hi hai. Ka'ab Ahbar se marwi hai ke aasman Arsh ke muqable mein aise hain jaise koi qandeel aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan ho. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) ka farman hai ke tumhare Rabb ke paas raat din kuch nahin, us ke Arsh ka noor us ke chehre ke noor se hai.
