Burai ke badle achhai sakhtiyon ke utarne ke waqt ki dua ta'leem ho rahi hai ke agar tu in badkaron par azab laye aur main in mein maujood hoon, toh mujhe in azabon se bacha lena. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Tirmidhi Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki duaon mein yeh jumla bhi hota tha ke aye Allah jab tu kisi qaum ke sath fitne ka irada kare, toh mujhe fitne mein dalne se pehle utha le. Allah Ta'ala is ki ta'leem dene ke baad farmata hai ke hum in azabon ko tujhe dikha dene par qadir hain, jo in kuffar par hamari janib se utarne wale hain. Phir woh baat sikhayi jati hai jo tamam mushkilon ki dawa, aur rafa karne wali hai aur woh yeh ke burai karne wale se bhalai ki jaye, taake uski adawat mohabbat se aur nafrat ulfat se badal jaye. Jaise ek aur ayat mein bhi hai ke bhalai se dafa kar toh jani dushman, dili dost ban jayega. Lekin yeh kaam unhi se ho sakta hai jo sabr karne wale hon. Ya'ni is ke hukm ki ta'meel aur is ki sifat ki tehseel sirf un logon se ho sakti hai jo logon ki takleef ko bardasht kar lene ke aadi ho jayen. Aur go woh burai karen lekin yeh bhalai karte jayen. Yeh wasf inhi logon ka hai jo bade naseeb dar hon, duniya aur akhirat ki bhalai jin ki qismat mein ho.

Shaitan se bachne ki duayen: Insaan ki burai se bachne ki behtareen tarkeeb bata kar phir Shaitan ki burai se bachne ki tarkeeb batayi jati hai ke Allah se dua karo ke woh tumhein Shaitan se bacha le. Is liye ke us ke fan-e-fareb se bachne ka hathiyar tumhare paas siwaye is ke aur nahin. Woh sulook-o-ehsan se bas mein nahin aane ke. Istiaza ke bayan mein hum likh aaye hain ke An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dua (A'udhu billahi-s-samii-il-aleemi minash-shaitanir-rajeem) min hamzihi wa nafkhihi wa nafthihi padha karte the. Aur zikr Shaitan ki shamooliyat ko rok deta hai. Khana peena, jima, zibh wagaira kul kamon ke shuru karne se pehle Allah ka zikr karna chahiye. Abu Dawood mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek dua yeh bhi thi: (Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-harami wa a'udhu minal-hadmi wa minal-gharaqi wa a'udhu bika an yatakhabbatani-sh-shaitanu indal-mawt). Aye Allah main tujh se bade budhape se aur dab kar mar jane se aur doob kar mar jane se panah mangta hoon aur is se bhi ke maut ke waqt Shaitan mujh ko behkawe. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek dua sikhate the ke neend uchat ho jane ke marz ko door karne ke liye hum sote waqt padha karen. Dua: (Bismillahi a'udhu bikalimatillahi-t-tammati min ghadabihi wa iqabihi wa min sharri ibadihi wa min hamazati-sh-shayateeni wa an yahdurun). Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ka dastoor tha ke apni aulad mein se jo hoshiyar hote unhein yeh dua sikha diya karte aur jo chhote nasamajh hote yaad na kar sakte un ke gale mein is dua ko likh kar latka dete. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Ghareeb batate hain.

Baad az marg bayan ho raha hai ke maut ke waqt kuffar aur badtareen gunahgar sakht nadim hote hain aur hasrat-o-afsos ke sath aarzu karte hain ke kaash ke hum duniya ki taraf lautaye jayen, taake hum nek aamal kar lein. Lekin us waqt woh umeed-e-fazool yeh aarzu lahasil hai. Chunancha Surah Munafiqun mein farmaya, jo hum ne diya hai hamari rah mein dete raho, is se pehle ke tum mein se kisi ki maut aa jaye, us waqt woh kahe ke aye Allah zara si mohlat de de to main sadqa khairat kar loon aur nek banda ban jaaun, lekin ajal aa jane ke baad kisi ko mohlat nahin milti, tumhare tamam aamal se Allah Ta'ala khabardar hai. Isi mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain. Maslan aayat (Wa-anzirin-nasa yauma ya'tihimul-azabu fayaqulul-lazina zalamu rabbana akh-khirna ila ajalin qaribin nujib da'wataka wa nattabi'ir-rusul) (14. Ibrahim: 44) aur aayat (Yauma ya'ti ta'wiluhu yaqulul-lazina nasuhu min qablu qad ja'at rusulu rabbina bil-haqqi fahal lana min shufa'a-a fayashfa'u lana au nuraddu fana'mala ghairallazi kunna na'malu qad khasiru anfusahum wa dalla anhum ma kanu yaftarun) (7. Al-A'raf: 53) aur aayat (Wa lau tara izil-mujrimuna nakisu ru'usihim inda rabbihim rabbana absarna wa sami'na farji'na na'mal salihan inna muqinun) (32. As-Sajdah: 12) tak aur aayat (Wa lau tara iz wuqufu ala rabbihim qala alaisa haza bil-haqqi qalu bala wa rabbina qala fazuqul-azaba bima kuntum takfurun) (6. Al-An'am: 30) tak aur aayat (Wa taraz-zalimina lamma ra'awul-azaba yaquluna hal ila maraddin min sabil) (42. Ash-Shura: 44) tak aur aayat (Qalu rabbana amattanas-nataini wa ahyaitanas-nataini fa'tarafna bizunubina fahal ila khurujin min sabil) (40. Ghafir: 11) aur is ke baad ki aayat (Wa hum yastarihuna fiha rabbana akhrijna na'mal salihan ghairallazi kunna na'malu awalam nu'ammirkum ma yatazzakkaru fihi man tazzakkara wa ja'akumun-naziru fazuqu famaz-zalimina min nasir) (35. Aap farmate hain, tum yun samajh lo ki meri maut aa chuki thi, lekin maine Allah se dua ki ki mujhe chand roz ki mohlat de di jaye taake main nekiyan karloon. Jaise farman hai ke koi dost kisi dost se ek dusre ko dekhne ke bawajood kuch na puchega. Saaf dekhega ke qareebi shakhs hai, museebat mein hai, gunahon ke bojh se dab raha hai lekin us ki taraf iltifat tak na karega, na kuch puchega, aankh pher lega. Jaise Quran mein hai ke "Us din aadmi apne bhai se, apni maa se, apne baap se, apni biwi se, aur apne bachon se bhagta phirega". Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala aglon pichlon ko jama karega phir ek munadi nida karega jis kisi ka koi haq kisi dusre ke zimme ho woh bhi aaye aur us se apna haq le jaye. Toh agarche kisi ka koi haq baap ke zimme ya apni aulad ke zimme ya apni biwi ke zimme ho woh bhi khush hota hua aur daudta hua aayega aur apne haq ke taqaze shuru karega, jaisa is aayat mein hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Fatima (R.A) mere jism ka ek tukda hai, jo cheez use na-khush kare woh mujhe bhi na-khush karti hai aur jo cheez use khush kare woh mujhe bhi khush karti hai. Qayamat ke roz sab rishte naate toot jayenge lekin mera nasab, mera sabab, meri rishtedari na tootegi. Is hadith ki asal Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Fatima (R.A) mere jism ka ek tukda hai, use naraz karne wali aur use satane wali cheezein mujhe naraz karne wali aur mujhe takleef pahunchane wali hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne mimbar par farmaya logon ka kya haal hai ke kehte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka rishta bhi aap ki qoum ko koi fayda na dega? Wallah mere rishte duniya mein aur aakhirat mein mile hue hain. Ae logo! Main tumhara meer-e-saman hoon, jab tum aaoge, ek shakhs kahega ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main falan bin falan hoon, main jawab dunga ke haan nasab toh main ne pehchan liya lekin tum logon ne mere baad bid'atein ijaad ki thin aur ediyon ke bal murtad ho gaye the. Musnad-e-Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) mein hum ne kayi sanadon se yeh riwayat ki hai ke jab aap ne Umme Kulsoom bint-e-Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) se nikah kiya toh farmaya karte the Wallah mujhe is nikah se sirf yeh gharz thi ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai ke har sabab-o-nasab Qayamat ke din kat jayega magar mera nasab aur sabab. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke aap ne un ka mehar az-rooye-tazeem-o-buzurgi chalis hazar muqarrar kiya tha. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya kul rishte naate aur sasurali talluqat bajuz mere aise talluqat ke Qayamat ke din kat jayenge. Ek hadith mein hai ke main ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke jahan mera nikah hua hai aur jis ka nikah mere saath hua hai woh sab Jannat mein bhi mere saath rahein toh Allah Ta'ala ne meri dua qabool farmayi.

Jis ki ek neki bhi gunahon se barh gayi woh kamyab hogaya, jahannam se azad aur jannat mein dakhil hogaya, apni murad ko pahunch gaya aur jis se darta tha us se bach gaya. Aur jis ki buraiyan bhalaiyon se barh gayin woh halak hue, nuqsan mein aagaye. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, Qayamat ke din tarazu par ek farishta muqarrar hoga jo har insan ko lakar tarazu ke paas beechon-beech khara karega, phir neki badi toli jayegi. Agar neki barh gayi toh ba-awaz-e-buland elan karega ke falan bin falan nijat pa gaya, ab is ke baad halakat is ke paas bhi nahin aayegi. Aur agar badi barh gayi toh nida karega aur sab ko suna kar kahega ke falan ka beta falan halak hua, ab woh bhalai se mehroom hogaya. Is ki sanad zaeef hai, Dawood ibn-e-Hajar rawi zaeef-o-matrook hai. Aise log hamesha jahannam mein rahenge, dozakh ki aag un ke munh jhulas degi, chehron ko jala degi, kamar ko sulga degi. Yeh bebas honge, aag ko hata na sakenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, pehle hi shole ki lipat un ka sara gosht-o-post haddiyon se alag kar ke un ke qadmon mein daal degi. Woh wahan bad-shakal honge, daant nikle honge, hont oopar charha hua aur neeche gira hua hoga, oopar ka hont toh talu tak pahuncha hua hoga aur neeche ka hont naaf tak aajayega.

Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya kul rishte naate aur sasurali talluqat bajuz mere aise talluqat ke Qayamat ke din kat jayenge. Ek hadith mein hai ke main ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke jahan mera nikah hua hai aur jis ka nikah mere saath hua hai woh sab Jannat mein bhi mere saath rahein toh Allah Ta'ala ne meri dua qabool farmayi.

Jis ki ek neki bhi gunahon se barh gayi woh kamyab hogaya, jahannam se azad aur jannat mein dakhil hogaya, apni murad ko pahunch gaya aur jis se darta tha us se bach gaya. Aur jis ki buraiyan bhalaiyon se barh gayin woh halak hue, nuqsan mein aagaye. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, Qayamat ke din tarazu par ek farishta muqarrar hoga jo har insan ko lakar tarazu ke paas beechon-beech khara karega, phir neki badi toli jayegi. Agar neki barh gayi toh ba-awaz-e-buland elan karega ke falan bin falan nijat pa gaya, ab is ke baad halakat is ke paas bhi nahin aayegi. Aur agar badi barh gayi toh nida karega aur sab ko suna kar kahega ke falan ka beta falan halak hua, ab woh bhalai se mehroom hogaya. Is ki sanad zaeef hai, Dawood ibn-e-Hajar rawi zaeef-o-matrook hai. Aise log hamesha jahannam mein rahenge, dozakh ki aag un ke munh jhulas degi, chehron ko jala degi, kamar ko sulga degi. Yeh bebas honge, aag ko hata na sakenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, pehle hi shole ki lipat un ka sara gosht-o-post haddiyon se alag kar ke un ke qadmon mein daal degi. Woh wahan bad-shakal honge, daant nikle honge, hont oopar charha hua aur neeche gira hua hoga, oopar ka hont toh talu tak pahuncha hua hoga aur neeche ka hont naaf tak aajayega.

Qabron se uthne ke baad jab jee uthne ka soor phoonka jayega aur log apni qabron se zinda ho kar uth khade honge, us din na toh koi rishte naate baqi rahenge. Na koi kisi se puchega, na baap ko aulad par shafqat hogi, na aulad baap ka gham khayegi. Ajab aapa-dhapi hogi. Jaise farman hai ke koi dost kisi dost se ek dusre ko dekhne ke bawajood kuch na puchega. Saaf dekhega ke qareebi shakhs hai, museebat mein hai, gunahon ke bojh se dab raha hai lekin us ki taraf iltifat tak na karega, na kuch puchega, aankh pher lega. Jaise Quran mein hai ke "Us din aadmi apne bhai se, apni maa se, apne baap se, apni biwi se, aur apne bachon se bhagta phirega". Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala aglon pichlon ko jama karega phir ek munadi nida karega jis kisi ka koi haq kisi dusre ke zimme ho woh bhi aaye aur us se apna haq le jaye. Toh agarche kisi ka koi haq baap ke zimme ya apni aulad ke zimme ya apni biwi ke zimme ho woh bhi khush hota hua aur daudta hua aayega aur apne haq ke taqaze shuru karega, jaisa is aayat mein hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Fatima (R.A) mere jism ka ek tukda hai, jo cheez use na-khush kare woh mujhe bhi na-khush karti hai aur jo cheez use khush kare woh mujhe bhi khush karti hai. Qayamat ke roz sab rishte naate toot jayenge lekin mera nasab, mera sabab, meri rishtedari na tootegi. Is hadith ki asal Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Fatima (R.A) mere jism ka ek tukda hai, use naraz karne wali aur use satane wali cheezein mujhe naraz karne wali aur mujhe takleef pahunchane wali hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne mimbar par farmaya logon ka kya haal hai ke kehte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ka rishta bhi aap ki qoum ko koi fayda na dega? Wallah mere rishte duniya mein aur aakhirat mein mile hue hain. Ae logo! Main tumhara meer-e-saman hoon, jab tum aaoge, ek shakhs kahega ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main falan bin falan hoon, main jawab dunga ke haan nasab toh main ne pehchan liya lekin tum logon ne mere baad bid'atein ijaad ki thin aur ediyon ke bal murtad ho gaye the. Mukammal aagahi ke baad bhi mehroom-e-hidayat kafiron ko un ke kufr aur gunahon par imaan na lane par Qayamat ke din jo daant-dupat hogi, us ka bayan ho raha hai ke un se Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga ke main ne tumhari taraf Rasool bheje thay, tum par kitabein nazil farmayi thin, tumhare shak zail kar diye thay, tumhari koi hujjat baqi nahin rakhi thi, jaise farman hai ke "taake logon ka uzr Rasoolon ke aane ke baad baqi na rahe" (4:165). Aur farmaya "hum jab tak Rasool na bhej dein azab nahin karte" (17:15). Ek aur riwayat mein hai "jab Jahannam mein koi jamaat jaye gi us se wahan ke daroghay poochein ge ke kya tumhare paas Allah ki taraf se aagah karne wale aaye na thay"? Us waqt yeh harman-naseeb log iqrar karein ge ke beshak teri hujjat poori ho gayi thi lekin hum apni badqismati aur sakht-dili ke baais durust na hue, apni gumrahi par ad gaye aur rah-e-rast par na chale. Allah ab to hamein phir duniya ki taraf bhej de, agar ab aisa karein to beshak hum zalim hain aur mustahiq-e-saza hain, jaise farman hai aayat (فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا فَهَلْ اِلٰى خُرُوْجٍ مِّنْ سَبِيْلٍ) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 11) hamein apni taqseeron ka iqrar hai, kya ab kisi tarah bhi chutkare ki rah mil sakti hai? Lekin jawab diya jaye ga ke ab sab raahein band hain. Daar-e-fana ho gaya, ab Daar-e-Jaza hai. Tauheed ke waqt shirk kiya, ab pachtane se kya hasil?

Nakaam aarzu: Kafir jab jahannam se nikalne ki aarzu karenge toh unhein jawab milega ke ab toh tum isi mein zillat ke sath pade rahoge, khabardar ab yeh sawal mujh se na karna. Aah! Yeh Kalam-e-Rahman hoga jo dozakhiyon ko har khayal se mayus karde ga. Allah hamein bachaye, aye Rahmaton wale! Allah hamein apne raham ke daman mein chhupa le, apni daant-dupat aur gusse se bacha le, Ameen.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke jahannami pehle toh darogha-e-jahannam ko bulayenge, chalis saal tak use pukarte rahenge lekin koi jawab na payenge. Chalis baras ke baad jawab milega ke tum yahin pade raho. Un ki pukar ki koi waqat na darogha-e-jahannam ke paas hogi na Allah Jalla Wa'ala ke paas. Phir barah-e-rast Allah Ta'ala se faryad karenge aur kahenge ke aye Allah! Hum apni badbakhti ki wajah se halak ho gaye, hum apni gumrahi mein doob gaye, aye Allah! Ab toh hamein yahan se nijat de, agar ab bhi hum yahi bure kaam karein toh jo chahe saza karna. Is ka jawab unhein duniya ki dugni umar tak na diya jaye ga. Phir farmaya jaye ga ke rahmat se door ho kar zaleel-o-khwar ho kar isi dozakh mein pade raho aur mujh se kalam na karo. Ab yeh mahaz mayus ho jayenge aur gadhon ki tarah chillate aur shor machate jalte aur bhunte rahenge. Is waqt un ke chehre badal jayenge, suratein maskh ho jayengi, yahan tak ke baaz momin shafa'at ki ijazat le kar aayenge lekin yahan kisi ko nahin pehchanenge. Jahannami unhein dekh kar kahenge ke main falan hoon lekin yeh jawab denge ke ghalat hai, hum tumhein nahin pehchante. Ab dozakhi log Allah ko pukarenge aur woh jawab payenge jo oopar mazkoor hua hai, phir dozakh ke darwaze band kar diye jayenge aur yeh wahin sadte rahenge.

Unhein sharminda aur pasheman karne ke liye un ka ek zabardast gunah pesh kiya jaye ga ke woh Allah ke pyare bandon ka mazaq udate the aur un ki du'aon par dil-lagi karte the. Woh momin apne Rab se bakhshish-o-rahmat talab karte the, use Rahman-ur-Rahimeen keh kar pukarte the lekin yeh use hansi mein udate the aur un ke bughz mein zikr-e-Rab chhod baithte the aur un ki ibadaton aur du'aon par hanste the. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Innal-lazina ajramu kanu minal-lazina amanu yadhakun) (83. Al-Mutaffifin: 29). Yani gunahgar imandaron se hanste the aur unhein mazaq mein udate the. Ab un se Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga ke main ne apne imandar sabr-guzar bandon ko badla de diya hai, woh sa'adat, salamat, nijat-o-falah pa chuke hain aur poore kamyab ho chuke hain.

Hisab-daan logon se daryaft kar liya jaye, jawab milega ke itni muddat ho ya zyada, lekin waqai mein woh aakhirat ki muddat ke muqable mein bahut hi kam hai. Agar tum isi ko jante hote toh is fani ko is jawadani par tarjeeh na dete aur burai karke is thodi si muddat mein is qadar Allah ko naraz na kardete. Woh zara sa waqt agar sabr-o-zabt se itaat-e-Ilahi mein basar kardete toh aaj raaj tha, khushi hi khushi thi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab Jannati Dozakhi apni apni jagah pahunch jayenge toh Janab-e-Bari Azza-o-Jal mominon se puchega ke tum duniya mein kitni muddat rahe? Woh sacha badshah is se pak hai aur us ke siwa koi mabood nahin. Woh Arsh-e-Azeem ka malik hai jo tamam makhlooq par misl chhat ke chhaya hua hai. Woh bahut bhala aur umda hai, khush-shakal aur nek-manzar hai, jaise farman hai zameen mein hum ne har joda umda paida kardiya hai. Khalifatul Muslimeen Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne apne aakhri khutbe mein Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya ke logo! Tum bekar aur abas paida nahin kiye gaye aur tum muhmal chhod nahin diye gaye. Yaad rakho ke wade ka ek din hai jis mein khud Allah Ta'ala faisle karne aur hukum farmane ke liye nazil hoga. Woh nuqsan mein pada, us ne khasara uthaya, woh be-naseeb aur badbakht hogaya, woh mehroom aur khali hath raha, jo Allah ki rahmat se door hogaya aur jannat se rok diya gaya, jis ki chaudai misl kul zameeno aur aasmano ke hai.

Kya tumhein maloom nahin ke kal Roz-e-Qayamat ke din Azaab-e-Ilahi se woh bach jayega, jis ke dilon mein us din ka khauf aaj hai aur jo is faani duniya ko is baqi Aakhirat par qurban kar raha hai, is thode ko is bahut ke hasil karne ke liye betakaan kharch kar raha hai aur apne is khauf ko aman se badalne ke asbaab muhayya kar raha hai. Kya tum nahin dekhte ke tum se guzashta log halak hue, jin ke qaim-maqam ab tum ho. Isi tarah tum bhi mita diye jaoge aur tumhare badle aayinda aane wale aayenge yahan tak ke ek waqt aayega ke saari duniya simat kar is Khair-ul-Wariseen ke darbar mein hazri degi. Logo khayal to karo ke tum din raat apni maut se qareeb ho rahe ho aur apne qadmon se apni gor ki taraf ja rahe ho, tumhare phal pak rahe hain, tumhari ummeeden khatam ho rahi hain, tumhari umrein poori ho rahi hain. Tumhari ajal nazdeek aa gayi hai, tum zameen ke garhon mein dafan kar diye jaoge, jahan na koi bistar hoga, na takiya, dost ahbaab chhoot jayenge, hisab-kitaab shuru ho jayega, aamaal samne aa jayenge, jo chhod aaye woh dusron ka ho jayega. Jo aage bhej chuke, use samne paoge, nekiyon ke mohtaj hoge, badiyon ki sazayein bhugtoge. Ae Allah ke bando! Allah se daro, us ki baatein samne aa jayen is se pehle maut tum ko uchak le jaye. Is se pehle jawab-dehi ke liye tayyar ho jao, itna kaha tha ke rone ke ghalbe ne aawaz buland kar di. Munh par chadar ka kona daal kar rone lage aur hazireen ki bhi aah-o-zari shuru ho gayi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek bimar shakhs jise koi jinn sata raha tha, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) ke paas aaya to aap ne 'Afahasibtum' se soorat ke khatm tak ki aayatein us ke kaan mein tilawat farmayin woh achha ho gaya. Jab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ka zikr aaya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Abdullah (R.A) tum ne us ke kaan mein kya padha tha?" Aap ne bataya to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Tum ne yeh aayatein us ke kaan mein padh kar use jila diya. Wallah in aayaton ko agar koi ba-imaan aur ba-yaqeen shakhs kisi pahad par padhe to woh bhi apni jagah se tal jaye." Abu Na'eem ne riwayat ki hai ke hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek lashkar mein bheja aur hukm farmaya ke hum subh-o-sham aayat (اَفَحَسِبْتُمْ اَنَّمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمْ اِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Mu'minoon: 115) padhte rahein hum ne barabar is ki tilawat dono waqt jaari rakhi. Alhamdulillah hum salamti aur ghaneemat ke sath wapas laute. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Meri ummat ka doobne se bachao kashtiyon mein sawar hone ke waqt yeh kehna hai. Dua-o-aayat (Bismillahil Malikil Haqqi wa ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrihi wal ardu jamee'an qabdatuhu yawmal qiyamati wassamawatu matwiyatum biyameenihi subhanahu wa ta'ala 'amma yushrikoon, bismillahi majreha wa mursaha inna Rabbi la Ghafoorur Raheem)."

Woh kahenge yahi koi ek aadh din. Allah farmaye ga phir toh bahut hi ache rahe ke itni si der ki nekiyon ka yeh badla paya ke meri rahmat, razamandi aur jannat hasil karli, jahan hameshangi hai. Phir jahannumiyon se yeh sawal hoga, woh bhi itni hi muddat batayenge toh Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga tumhari tijarat badi ghate wali hui ke itni si muddat mein tum ne meri narazgi, gussa aur jahannum khareed liya, jahan tum hamesha pade rahoge. Kya tum log yeh samjhe hue ho ke tum bekar, be-qasd-o-irada paida kiye gaye ho? Koi hikmat tumhari paidaish mein nahin? Mahaz khel ke taur par tumhein paida kardiya gaya hai? Ke misl janwaron ke tum uchalte koodte phiro, sawab-o-azab ke mustahiq ho? Yeh guman ghalat hai, tum ibadat ke liye, Allah ke hukumon ki baja-awari ke liye paida kiye gaye ho. Kya tum yeh khayal karke be-fikr hogaye ho ke tumhein hamari taraf lautna hi nahin? Yeh bhi ghalat khayal hai, jaise farmaya aayat (Ayahsabu al-insanu an yutraka suda) (75. Al-Qiyamah: 36). Kya log yeh guman karte hain ke woh muhmal chhod diye jayenge? Allah ki zaat is se buland-o-bartar hai ke woh koi abas kaam kare, bekar banaye bigade. Woh sacha badshah is se pak hai aur us ke siwa koi mabood nahin. Woh Arsh-e-Azeem ka malik hai jo tamam makhlooq par misl chhat ke chhaya hua hai. Woh bahut bhala aur umda hai, khush-shakal aur nek-manzar hai, jaise farman hai zameen mein hum ne har joda umda paida kardiya hai. Khalifatul Muslimeen Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne apne aakhri khutbe mein Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya ke logo! Tum bekar aur abas paida nahin kiye gaye aur tum muhmal chhod nahin diye gaye. Yaad rakho ke wade ka ek din hai jis mein khud Allah Ta'ala faisle karne aur hukum farmane ke liye nazil hoga. Woh nuqsan mein pada, us ne khasara uthaya, woh be-naseeb aur badbakht hogaya, woh mehroom aur khali hath raha, jo Allah ki rahmat se door hogaya aur jannat se rok diya gaya, jis ki chaudai misl kul zameeno aur aasmano ke hai.

Kya tumhein maloom nahin ke kal Roz-e-Qayamat ke din Azaab-e-Ilahi se woh bach jayega, jis ke dilon mein us din ka khauf aaj hai aur jo is faani duniya ko is baqi Aakhirat par qurban kar raha hai, is thode ko is bahut ke hasil karne ke liye betakaan kharch kar raha hai aur apne is khauf ko aman se badalne ke asbaab muhayya kar raha hai. Kya tum nahin dekhte ke tum se guzashta log halak hue, jin ke qaim-maqam ab tum ho. Isi tarah tum bhi mita diye jaoge aur tumhare badle aayinda aane wale aayenge yahan tak ke ek waqt aayega ke saari duniya simat kar is Khair-ul-Wariseen ke darbar mein hazri degi. Logo khayal to karo ke tum din raat apni maut se qareeb ho rahe ho aur apne qadmon se apni gor ki taraf ja rahe ho, tumhare phal pak rahe hain, tumhari ummeeden khatam ho rahi hain, tumhari umrein poori ho rahi hain. Tumhari ajal nazdeek aa gayi hai, tum zameen ke garhon mein dafan kar diye jaoge, jahan na koi bistar hoga, na takiya, dost ahbaab chhoot jayenge, hisab-kitaab shuru ho jayega, aamaal samne aa jayenge, jo chhod aaye woh dusron ka ho jayega. Jo aage bhej chuke, use samne paoge, nekiyon ke mohtaj hoge, badiyon ki sazayein bhugtoge. Ae Allah ke bando! Allah se daro, us ki baatein samne aa jayen is se pehle maut tum ko uchak le jaye. Is se pehle jawab-dehi ke liye tayyar ho jao, itna kaha tha ke rone ke ghalbe ne aawaz buland kar di. Munh par chadar ka kona daal kar rone lage aur hazireen ki bhi aah-o-zari shuru ho gayi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek bimar shakhs jise koi jinn sata raha tha, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) ke paas aaya to aap ne 'Afahasibtum' se soorat ke khatm tak ki aayatein us ke kaan mein tilawat farmayin woh achha ho gaya. Jab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ka zikr aaya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Abdullah (R.A) tum ne us ke kaan mein kya padha tha?" Aap ne bataya to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Tum ne yeh aayatein us ke kaan mein padh kar use jila diya. Wallah in aayaton ko agar koi ba-imaan aur ba-yaqeen shakhs kisi pahad par padhe to woh bhi apni jagah se tal jaye." Abu Na'eem ne riwayat ki hai ke hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek lashkar mein bheja aur hukm farmaya ke hum subh-o-sham aayat (اَفَحَسِبْتُمْ اَنَّمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَّاَنَّكُمْ اِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Mu'minoon: 115) padhte rahein hum ne barabar is ki tilawat dono waqt jaari rakhi. Alhamdulillah hum salamti aur ghaneemat ke sath wapas laute. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain "Meri ummat ka doobne se bachao kashtiyon mein sawar hone ke waqt yeh kehna hai. Dua-o-aayat (Bismillahil Malikil Haqqi wa ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrihi wal ardu jamee'an qabdatuhu yawmal qiyamati wassamawatu matwiyatum biyameenihi subhanahu wa ta'ala 'amma yushrikoon, bismillahi majreha wa mursaha inna Rabbi la Ghafoorur Raheem)."

Agar nek-o-kar rehte toh Allah ke nek bandon ke sath un nekiyon ka bada ajar paate. Aaj un se sawal hoga ke tum duniya mein kis qadar rahe? Jawab denge ke bahut hi kam, ek din ya us se bhi kam. Hisab-daan logon se daryaft kar liya jaye, jawab milega ke itni muddat ho ya zyada, lekin waqai mein woh aakhirat ki muddat ke muqable mein bahut hi kam hai. Dalail ke sath mushrik ka muwahhid hona mushrikon ko Allah Wahid dara raha hai aur bayan farma raha hai ke un ke paas un ke shirk ki koi daleel nahin. Yeh jumla-e-mu'tariza hai aur jawab-e-shart 'fa-innama' wale jumle ke zimn mein hai yani is ka hisab Allah ke haan hai. Kafir us ke paas kamyab nahin ho sakte. Woh nijat se mehroom reh jate hain. Ek shakhs se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke tu kis kis ko poojta hai? Us ne kaha sirf Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu ko. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab kaam aane wala wahi hai to phir us ke sath in dusron ki ibadat ki kya zaroorat hai? Kya tera khayal hai ke woh akela tujhe kafi na hoga? Jab us ne kaha yeh to nahin keh sakta, albatta irada yeh hai ke auron ki ibadat karke us ka poora shukr baja la sakoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, SubhanAllah! Ilm ke sath yeh be-ilmi? Jante ho aur phir anjan bane jate ho? Ab koi jawab ban na pada. Chunancha woh musalman ho jane ke baad kaha karte the mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qail kar liya. Yeh hadith mursal hai Tirmidhi mein sanadan bhi marwi hai. Phir ek dua taleem farmayi gayi. 'Ghafir' ke ma'ni jab woh mutlaq ho to gunahon ko mita dene aur unhein logon se chupa dene ke aate hain. Aur 'Rahmat' ke ma'ni sahih rah par qaim rakhne aur achche aqwal-o-af'al ki taufiq dene ke hote hain. Alhamdulillah Surah Mominoon ki tafsir khatam hui.
